InternVLA-A1.5: Unifying Understanding, Latent Foresight, and Action for Compositional Generalization VLA

vision-language-action model latent foresight compositional generalization robot manipulation frozen video generation model

简要说明：InternVLA-A1.5 通过将 VLM 理解、基于冻结视频生成器的潜在未来预测以及轻量级专家中的连续动作生成统一起来，在机器人操作中实现了强大的组合泛化和长程执行。

TLDR: InternVLA-A1.5 unifies VLM understanding, latent future prediction via a frozen video generator, and continuous action generation in a lightweight expert, achieving strong compositional generalization and long-horizon execution in robot manipulation.

Abstract: Unified models for robot manipulation aim to equip one policy with both the semantic priors of pretrained VLMs and the physical dynamics learned through future prediction. In practice, existing designs tend to erode the semantics of the pretrained backbone, suffer interference among heterogeneous objectives, and learn future prediction from scratch in pixel space, leaving the dynamics priors of pretrained video generators unexploited. We present InternVLA-A1.5, which builds the policy on a native VLM backbone that keeps training on VQA and subtask prediction, and attaches a lightweight unified expert for continuous action generation. Future prediction is recast as a latent-querying problem, where a small set of learnable foresight tokens condenses the task-relevant future into a compact latent code under the supervision of a frozen pretrained video generation model, so the policy inherits world-model dynamics priors without ever learning pixel-level generation. The video branch is discarded at inference, keeping real-time control. Pretrained on 1.2M robot episodes and 3M multimodal samples, InternVLA-A1.5 achieves the best overall results on all six simulation benchmarks. In the real world, the preserved semantics deliver the strongest compositional generalization on held-out instruction bindings, and the two designs together sustain long-horizon execution.

摘要（中文）：统一机器人操控模型旨在为单一策略同时赋予预训练视觉语言模型（VLM）的语义先验知识，以及通过未来预测习得的物理动力学特性。在实践中，现有设计往往侵蚀预训练骨干网络的语义信息，导致异构目标之间的干扰，并在像素空间中从头学习未来预测，未能充分利用预训练视频生成器的动力学先验知识。我们提出了InternVLA-A1.5，该模型在原生VLM骨干网络上构建策略，持续进行视觉问答（VQA）与子任务预测训练，并附加一个轻量级统一专家模块用于连续动作生成。未来预测被重新定义为潜在查询问题：通过一组少量可学习的预见性令牌，在冻结的预训练视频生成模型监督下，将任务相关的未来信息压缩为紧凑的潜在编码，从而使策略继承世界模型的动力学先验知识，而无需学习像素级生成。推理阶段丢弃视频分支，保持实时控制能力。基于120万条机器人操作轨迹与300万条多模态样本的预训练，InternVLA-A1.5在全部六个仿真基准测试中均取得最优综合性能。在真实世界中，保留的语义信息在未见过指令绑定任务中展现出最强的组合泛化能力，而两种设计共同支撑了长时域任务执行。

Authors: Haoxiang Ma, Junhao Cai, Xiaoxu Xu, Hao Li, Yuyin Yang, Yang Tian, Jiafei Cao, Hongrui Zhu, Zherui Qiu, Zhaxizhuoma, Yuqiang Yang, Jiaqi Peng, Xueyuan Wei, Yangkun Zhu, Jiahao Jiang, Xing Gao, Hanqing Wang, Feng Yuan, Kailin Li, Xueyue Zhu, Tai Wang, Yan Ding, Jiangmiao Pang, Jia Zeng, Jingjing Zhang, Bowen Zhou, Yao Mu, Chunhua Shen, Weinan Zhang

SEAM: Smooth Execution of Action-Chunked Motion for Vision-Language-Action Policies VLA

flow matching VLA action-chunked motion Velocity-guided Loss Steering inference-time correction smooth execution

简要说明：SEAM 提出了一种无需训练的推理时方法，通过利用前一动作块未执行的尾部作为分析参考，减少动作块化 VLA 策略中的运动不连续性。

TLDR: SEAM introduces a training-free inference-time method that reduces motion discontinuities in action-chunked VLA policies by leveraging the unexecuted tail of the previous chunk as an analytic reference.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies that execute fixed-length action chunks can exhibit multimodal bifurcation: a cross-chunk inconsistency in which adjacent chunks generated from independent Gaussian latents can converge to incompatible trajectory modes, producing abrupt discontinuities at chunk boundaries. Existing remedies either require backpropagation through the policy at each denoising step, rely on rejection sampling, or require retraining, each trading computational cost or task reliability for smoother transitions. We propose SEAM (Smooth Execution of Action-Chunked Motion), a training-free inference-time method for flow matching VLAs. SEAM exploits a simple synchronous-execution insight: after the robot consumes the executed prefix, the previous chunk's unexecuted tail is already available as an analytic consistency reference. Its core mechanism, Velocity-guided Loss Steering (VLS), derives a time-dependent target from this tail and applies a closed-form correction after each Euler step without backpropagating through the policy network. On LIBERO-10 with pi_0.5, SEAM reduces boundary jerk by 28%, reduces chunk transition discontinuity by 27%, preserves baseline-level task success, and keeps denoising-loop cost near the unguided baseline.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在执行固定长度动作块时可能出现多模态分叉现象：由独立高斯潜变量生成的相邻动作块在块边界处收敛至不相容的轨迹模式，从而产生突变的不连续性。现有解决方法要么需要在每个去噪步骤中通过策略网络进行反向传播，要么依赖拒绝采样，要么需要重新训练，这些方法均以计算成本或任务可靠性为代价来换取更平滑的过渡。本文提出SEAM（平滑执行分块动作运动），一种面向流匹配VLA的免训练推理阶段方法。SEAM利用简单的同步执行机制：当机器人消耗已执行的前缀动作后，前一个动作块中未执行的尾部可直接作为解析一致性参考。其核心机制——速度引导损失调控（VLS）——从该尾部推导出时间依赖目标，并在每个欧拉步骤后施加闭式修正，无需通过策略网络进行反向传播。在搭载pi_0.5的LIBERO-10基准测试中，SEAM将边界急动度降低28%，动作块过渡不连续性降低27%，保持基线任务成功率，并将去噪循环计算开销维持在接近未引导基线的水平。

Authors: Dijia Zhan, Xuemiao Xu, Jinyi Li, Jie Tang

Mask2Real-WM: Segmentation Masks as a Sim-to-Real Bridge for Controllable Dexterous World Models WorldModel

world model dexterous manipulation sim-to-real segmentation action-conditioned

简要说明：Mask2Real-WM 提出了一种用于灵巧操作的两阶段动作条件世界模型，将像素预测分解为基于分割的动力学和基于扩散的渲染，从而在有限真实数据下实现仿真到现实的迁移。

TLDR: Mask2Real-WM introduces a two-stage action-conditioned world model for dexterous manipulation that decouples pixel prediction into segmentation-based dynamics and diffusion-based rendering, enabling sim-to-real transfer with limited real data.

Abstract: Action-conditioned world models allow robots to predict the future consequences of candidate actions without additional physical interaction, supporting policy evaluation, planning, and data augmentation. We present Mask2Real-WM, a two-stage action-conditioned world model for dexterous manipulation that decouples pixel prediction into a dynamics model and a rendering model. The dynamics model predicts future segmentation masks from past masks and 23-DoF action sequences. The rendering model maps the predicted masks to photorealistic RGB using a ControlNet-augmented Stable Video Diffusion backbone. The smaller sim-to-real gap in segmentation space enables the dynamics model to benefit from large-scale pretraining on over 50 h of synthetic simulation data, followed by fine-tuning on fewer than 2.5 h of real demonstrations. Experiments on a dexterous pick-and-place benchmark show that mask conditioning and simulation pretraining are both required for per-DoF action controllability across all 23 degrees of freedom. In contrast, monolithic baselines capture broad hand and end-effector trajectories but do not reliably reflect fine-grained, per-joint action effects.

摘要（中文）：动作条件世界模型使机器人能够在不额外进行物理交互的情况下预测候选动作的未来结果，从而支持策略评估、规划与数据增强。我们提出Mask2Real-WM，一种用于灵巧操作的两阶段动作条件世界模型，将像素预测解耦为动力学模型与渲染模型。动力学模型根据历史掩码及23自由度动作序列预测未来分割掩码。渲染模型利用经ControlNet增强的稳定视频扩散骨干网络，将预测掩码映射为照片级真实感RGB图像。分割空间中的模拟-现实差异较小，使得动力学模型能够受益于超过50小时合成仿真数据的大规模预训练，随后在不足2.5小时的真实演示数据上进行微调。在灵巧抓取与放置基准上的实验表明，掩码条件化与仿真预训练对于所有23个自由度的逐自由度动作可控性均不可或缺。相比之下，整体式基线方法虽能捕捉大致的手部与末端执行器轨迹，但无法可靠反映细粒度的逐关节动作效果。

Authors: Riccardo O. Feingold, Davide Liconti, Chenyu Yang, Robert K. Katzschmann

From Fixed to Free Cameras: Calibration-Free View-Robust Vision-Language-Action Model VLA

calibration-free view-robust camera-centric action hand-eye matrix monocular RGB

简要说明：CamVLA 提出了一种无需标定的 VLA 模型，通过预测以相机为中心的执行器动作和手眼矩阵，将动作预测与相机几何解耦，从而在仅使用单目 RGB 图像的情况下实现对未见视角的鲁棒机器人控制。

TLDR: CamVLA introduces a calibration-free VLA model that decouples action prediction from camera geometry by predicting camera-centric end-effector actions and a hand-eye matrix, enabling robust robot control from unseen viewpoints using a single monocular RGB image.

Abstract: Real-world robot deployment rarely maintains the training-stage camera setup, where cameras often experience repositioning or remounting depending on actual scenarios. Existing view-robust Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies tolerate such camera variations only when the camera extrinsics are explicitly provided, making them fragile and hard to use especially when view robustness is critical. We argue that the policy should not be told where the camera is, but rather figure it out by itself. To this end, we introduce Camera-Centric VLA (CamVLA), a new VLA model that decouples manipulation controls from camera geometry by predicting (i) a camera-centric end-effector action expressed in the local camera frame, and (ii) a 6-DoF hand-eye matrix relating cameras to the robot base. A deterministic geometric transformation composes the two predictions into a robot base-frame action. This disentangles how I should move in pose-independent camera-centric action generation from where I am looking from in camera-perspective geometric grounding. The resulting policy is calibration-free, depth-free, and single-view, requiring only a single monocular RGB image as the visual observation and task instruction at deployment. Evaluations in both simulation and real-world robot data show that CamVLA consistently improves success rates across diverse unseen viewpoints. Project page: https://alibaba-damo-academy.github.io/CamVLA/.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 实际部署中，机器人很少能维持训练阶段的相机设置，相机常因具体场景需要被重新定位或安装。现有视角鲁棒的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略仅在显式提供相机外参时才能容忍此类相机变化，这使得它们在视角鲁棒性至关重要的场景下脆弱且难以使用。我们认为策略不应被告知相机的位置，而应自行推断。为此，我们提出以相机为中心的VLA模型——CamVLA，该新模型通过预测（i）基于局部相机帧表达的以相机为中心末端执行器动作，以及（ii）连接相机与机器人基座的6自由度手眼矩阵，将操控控制与相机几何解耦。确定性几何变换将这两个预测合成为机器人基座坐标系下的动作。这实现了“我应该如何移动”（与姿态无关的相机中心动作生成）与“我从何处观察”（相机视角几何定位）的解耦。所得策略无需标定、无需深度信息且仅依赖单视图，部署时仅需单目RGB图像作为视觉观测与任务指令。在仿真与真实机器人数据上的评估表明，CamVLA在多种未见过的相机视角下均能持续提升任务成功率。项目页面：https://alibaba-damo-academy.github.io/CamVLA/。

Authors: Wenhao Li, Xueying Jiang, Quanhao Qian, Deli Zhao, Shijian Lu, Gongjie Zhang, Ran Xu

Deform360: A Massive Multi-view Visuotactile Dataset for Deformable World Models WorldModel

world models deformable objects visuotactile dataset 3D tracking robot planning

简要说明：Deform360是一个大规模视觉触觉数据集，包含198个可变形物体、1980个交互序列和多视角/触觉数据，用于评估2D视频与3D粒子世界模型，并展示了真实机器人规划应用。

TLDR: Deform360 is a large-scale visuotactile dataset with 198 deformable objects, 1,980 interaction sequences, and multi-view/tactile data for benchmarking world models, including 2D video and 3D particle-based methods, with a demonstration on real robot planning.

Abstract: Predicting object dynamics (i.e., world modeling) is a fundamental challenge for robotic manipulation, and modeling deformable objects presents a particularly difficult case due to their high-dimensional state spaces and complex material properties. While current world models approach this through two distinct paradigms: learning the dynamics over the 2D pixel space or more explicit 3D geometric space. A systematic understanding of their relative strengths and limitations remains elusive due to the lack of diverse, large-scale real-world data. To address this, we present Deform360, a large-scale visuotactile dataset featuring 198 daily-life objects, 1,980 interaction sequences, and over 215 hours of observations from 41 surround-view cameras and bimanual tactile grippers to capture both global motion and contact-induced local deformations. Leveraging a novel markerless visuotactile 3D tracking pipeline to extract dense geometry and motion, we systematically evaluate current state-of-the-art world models, comparing 2D video models against 3D particle models. Finally, we provide a preliminary demonstration indicating the real-world applicability of our dataset by performing robot planning tasks on deformable objects. Our analysis reveals key insights into the trade-offs between structural priors and scalability, providing a solid benchmark for future research in generalizable deformable object-centric world modeling. Project website: https://deform360.lhy.xyz

摘要（中文）：预测物体动力学（即世界建模）是机器人操作领域的一项基础性挑战，而由于可变形物体具有高维状态空间和复杂的材料属性，对其进行建模尤为困难。当前的世界模型主要通过两种不同的范式来解决这一问题：在二维像素空间或更明确的三维几何空间上学习动力学。然而，由于缺乏多样化、大规模的真实世界数据，对这两种范式相对优势与局限性的系统理解仍不明确。为解决这一问题，我们提出了Deform360——一个大规模视触觉数据集，包含198个日常物体、1,980个交互序列，以及来自41台环绕视角相机和双臂触觉夹爪超过215小时的观测数据，用以捕捉全局运动及接触引发的局部形变。利用一种新型的无标记视触觉三维跟踪流程来提取密集几何与运动信息，我们系统评估了当前最先进的世界模型，比较了二维视频模型与三维粒子模型。最后，我们通过执行针对可变形物体的机器人规划任务，提供了初步演示，表明该数据集在现实世界中的适用性。我们的分析揭示了结构先验与可扩展性之间权衡的关键见解，为未来可泛化、以可变形物体为中心的世界建模研究提供了坚实的基准。项目网站：https://deform360.lhy.xyz

Authors: Hongyu Li, Wanjia Fu, Xiaoyan Cong, Zekun Li, Binghao Huang, Hanxiao Jiang, Xintong He, Yiqing Liang, Rao Fu, Tao Lu, Srinath Sridhar, Kevin A. Smith, George Konidaris, Yunzhu Li

Cortex: A Bidirectionally Aligned Embodied Agent Framework for Long-horizon Manipulation VLA

bidirectionally aligned long-horizon manipulation canonical skill primitives VLM-to-VLA zero-shot completion

简要说明：Cortex 提出了一种双向对齐的具身代理框架，通过将子任务标准化为32个规范技能原语，弥合了高层VLM计划与低层VLA执行之间的差距，实现了零样本的真实世界长时域操作任务。

TLDR: Cortex introduces a bidirectionally aligned embodied agent framework that bridges high-level VLM plans and low-level VLA executions for long-horizon manipulation, standardizing subtasks into 32 canonical skill primitives and demonstrating zero-shot real-world task completion.

Abstract: While recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models show promise toward generalist manipulation policies, they struggle with long-horizon tasks due to their Markovian nature-relying solely on current observations. Hierarchical dual-system methods address this but suffer from a gap between high-level planning semantics and low-level execution kinematics. We introduce Cortex, a bidirectionally aligned embodied agent framework with a customized planning interface that conveys executable and tractable subtask plans from high-level VLM to low-level VLA. Specifically, we standardize manipulation subtasks into 32 canonical skill primitives and inject tractability principles, such as representative object attributes and improved trajectory reachability, into the data generation pipeline. This enables automatic annotation of over 4k hours of open-source video data and generation of 30 hours of simulation data. We further devise an event-balanced sampling strategy to construct training data for fine-tuning the framework to better handle planning ambiguity during subtask transitions, enhanced by carefully designed harness engineering from task contexts to skill constraints during inference. Both open-loop VLM and closed-loop system evaluations demonstrate Cortex's efficacy, e.g., it outperforms monolithic baselines by 3.1% on Libero-long and 4.1% on RoboTwin. Notably, Cortex's generalist VLM enables zero-shot completion of unseen real-world long-horizon tasks, such as multi-stage chemistry experiments, by simply combining with a fine-tuned VLA-a capability infeasible through VLA fine-tuning alone.

摘要（中文）：近期，视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在通用操控策略方面展现出潜力，但受限于其马尔可夫性质——仅依赖当前观测——在处理长时域任务时存在困难。分层式双系统方法虽可应对此问题，却面临高层规划语义与低层执行运动学之间的鸿沟。我们提出Cortex框架，这是一种双向对齐的具身智能体框架，配备定制化规划接口，能够将高层视觉语言模型（VLM）中可执行且易处理的子任务规划传递至低层VLA。具体而言，我们将操控子任务标准化为32种典型技能基元，并将可处理性原则（如代表性物体属性和改进的轨迹可达性）注入数据生成流水线。这一方法实现了对超4000小时开源视频数据的自动标注，并生成30小时仿真数据。我们进一步设计事件平衡采样策略构建训练数据以微调框架，从而更好地处理子任务转换期间的规划模糊性，并通过推理阶段从任务上下文到技能约束的精心设计的约束工程加以强化。开环VLM与闭环系统评估均验证了Cortex的有效性，例如在Libero-long与RoboTwin基准上分别超越单体基线3.1%与4.1%。值得注意的是，Cortex的通用VLM仅需与微调后的VLA简单结合，即可零样本完成未见过的真实世界长时域任务（如多阶段化学实验）——这一能力无法通过单独微调VLA实现。

Authors: Jiaqi Peng, Xiqian Yu, Delin Feng, Yuqiang Yang, Wenzhe Cai, Jing Xiong, Ganlin Yang, Jinliang Zheng, Jiafei Cao, Xueyuan Wei, Jiangmiao Pang, Yuan Shen, Tai Wang

TypeGo: An OS Runtime for Embodied Agents Locomotion

embodied agents LLM-based planning asynchronous execution real-time control quadruped robot

简要说明：TypeGo为具身智能体设计了一种类似操作系统的运行时系统，将基于LLM的规划组织为异步循环，使执行与规划重叠，从而降低延迟并支持并发任务，在四足机器人上进行了验证。

TLDR: TypeGo proposes an OS-like runtime for embodied agents that structures LLM-based planning as asynchronous loops, overlapping execution with planning to reduce latency and support concurrent tasks, demonstrated on a quadruped robot.

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can plan behavior for embodied agents from natural language, but treating the LLM as a request/response oracle on the critical path is fundamentally at odds with real-time control and concurrent goals. We argue for an operating-system-style runtime for embodied agents, and instantiate this idea in an early prototype, TypeGo. TypeGo structures LLM-based planning as asynchronous loops at multiple timescales that overlap with execution, and manages the agent's physical body like an OS manages hardware: the Skill Kernel arbitrates typed physical subsystems among concurrent per-task processes, a scheduler preempts them and resumes or replaces each by source, and speculative skill streaming hides LLM latency behind ongoing motion, while a fast first-action path yields visible feedback within a second. Users program behavior through natural language prescriptions that TypeGo dispatches to the LLM-based planners or compiles into low-latency interrupt handlers. Our prototype of Kalos, a Unitree Go2 quadruped, provides preliminary evidence for the design: in our current task suite, it cuts per-step delay by 50% over step-by-step planning and time-to-first-action by 73% over monolithic planning, while admitting concurrent tasks at low scheduling overhead.

摘要（中文）：大型语言模型（LLMs）能够通过自然语言为具身智能体规划行为，但将LLM视为关键路径上的请求/响应预言机，本质上与实时控制和并发目标相悖。我们主张为具身智能体设计一套操作系统风格的运行时环境，并在早期原型系统TypeGo中实现了这一理念。TypeGo将基于LLM的规划构建为与执行过程重叠的多时间尺度异步循环，并像操作系统管理硬件那样管理智能体的物理实体：Skill Kernel在并发任务进程间仲裁带类型的物理子系统，调度器可抢占这些进程并根据源来源恢复或替换它们，推测性技能流将LLM延迟隐藏在持续运动背后，而快速首次动作路径可在1秒内产生可见反馈。用户通过自然语言指令编写行为程序，TypeGo将其分派给基于LLM的规划器或编译为低延迟中断处理程序。我们在宇树Go2四足机器人Kalos原型上的实验为这一设计提供了初步验证：在当前任务套件中，其单步延迟相比逐步规划降低50%，相比整体规划首次动作延迟降低73%，同时能以低调度开销支持并发任务。

Authors: Guojun Chen, Alex Schott, Lin Zhong

VLM-CASE: Vision-Language Model Enabled Context-Adaptive Safety Envelopes for Anticipatory Safe Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

vision-language model safety envelope model predictive control autonomous driving adverse weather

简要说明：本文提出VLM-CASE框架，利用视觉语言模型根据路面和可见度条件自适应调整安全包络（制动/转向极限），通过模型预测控制实现恶劣条件下的预判安全驾驶，并在CARLA仿真中验证。

TLDR: This paper proposes VLM-CASE, a framework that uses a vision-language model to adapt safety envelopes (braking/steering limits) based on road surface and visibility conditions, enabling anticipatory safe driving in adverse conditions via model predictive control, validated in CARLA simulation.

Abstract: Adverse driving conditions, such as bad weather, remain a principal barrier to autonomous driving because they degrade two things at once: what the vehicle can perceive and what it can physically do. Human drivers cope by anticipation, reasoning about the scene and re-budgeting speed, following distance, and steering before grip or sight is lost, whereas current autonomous driving systems at best react after the fact. This paper proposes VLM-CASE, a framework that gives an autonomous vehicle this anticipatory capacity while keeping its motion bounded by a formal safety model at all times. A vision-language model (VLM), fine-tuned with low-rank adaptation (LoRA), reasons about the scene from the front-camera image and reports the road surface and visibility conditions. This output parametrizes a context-adaptive safety envelope (CASE), derived from physical limits and the guarantees of responsibility-sensitive safety, that couples braking and steering through a shared friction budget. A model predictive controller then drives freely within the envelope, while the VLM runs asynchronously so it never blocks the real-time control loop. We validate the framework in closed-loop CARLA simulation on tasks that demand both lateral and longitudinal control, across a range of weather, road-surface, and lighting conditions. The resulting controller, VLM-CASE-MPC, completes all trials, outperforming a conventional MPC baseline and a state-of-the-art VLM-integrated controller. Ablations confirm that the gains come from context adaptation, with the friction and visibility adaptations proving complementary. Furthermore, the framework is controller-agnostic and pairs with almost any low-level controller, offering a promising direction for safe autonomous driving. The dataset and supplementary materials for VLM-CASE are available at https://github.com/ytj254/VLM-CASE.

摘要（中文）：恶劣驾驶条件（如恶劣天气）仍是自动驾驶面临的主要障碍，因为这些条件会同时削弱两个关键能力：车辆的感知能力与物理操控能力。人类驾驶员通过预判能力来应对——在抓地力或视野丧失之前，通过场景推理重新规划车速、跟车距离及转向策略，而当前自动驾驶系统至多只能在事后做出反应。本文提出VLM-CASE框架，该框架赋予自动驾驶车辆预判能力，同时使其运动始终受形式化安全模型约束。通过低秩适配进行微调的视觉语言模型（VLM）从前置摄像头图像中推理场景信息，输出路面状况与能见度条件。这些输出参数化了基于物理极限和责任敏感安全保证推导的上下文自适应安全包络（CASE），该包络通过共享摩擦预算耦合制动与转向操作。随后模型预测控制器在包络内自由行驶，VLM异步运行以避免阻塞实时控制回路。我们在CARLA闭环仿真环境中，针对需要横向与纵向联合控制任务，在不同天气、路面及光照条件下验证该框架。所构建的VLM-CASE-MPC控制器完成全部测试，性能优于传统MPC基线方法与当前最先进的VLM集成控制器。消融实验证实性能提升源自上下文自适应机制，且摩擦自适应与能见度自适应具有互补性。此外，该框架具有控制器无关性，可与几乎所有底层控制器配合，为安全自动驾驶提供了有前景的发展方向。VLM-CASE数据集及补充材料可访问 https://github.com/ytj254/VLM-CASE 获取。

Authors: Tianjia Yang, Ke Li, Ruwen Qin, Xianbiao Hu

Green for Go, Red for No: Visual Grounding via Semantic Segmentation for VLA Navigation Policies VLN

visual grounding VLA navigation semantic segmentation waypoint error trajectory length regularization

简要说明：本文首次对视觉接地在VLA导航策略中的效果进行实证评估，通过实时分割突出可通行/不可通行区域，在不重新训练模型的情况下降低了路径点误差。

TLDR: This paper presents the first empirical evaluation of visual grounding for VLA navigation policies, using real-time segmentation to highlight traversable/non-traversable areas, which reduces waypoint error without model retraining.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable robot navigation from natural language and visual goals, but remain susceptible to perceptual distractions and ambiguous scene interpretations. This paper presents the first empirical evaluation of visual grounding for VLA navigation policies. We propose a real-time segmentation-based grounding method that highlights traversable areas in green and non-traversable areas in red using SegFormer. Two variants are evaluated: observation-only segmentation and joint observation-goal augmentation. Using OmniVLA on the Grand Tour dataset, we show that visual grounding reduces the mean waypoint error by 27-44% at the farthest waypoint, depending on the instruction length. The benefits are greater for long instructions than for short instructions, and grounding provides little improvement for image goals. Normalized error analysis indicates that grounding primarily acts as a trajectory length regularizer, reducing the predicted path length by 30% without improving per-unit-distance reasoning. Our results indicate that visual grounding offers a simple, computationally inexpensive method to improve VLA navigation without model retraining, although it cannot compensate for missing training signals in out-of-distribution instructions.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型能够根据自然语言和视觉目标实现机器人导航，但仍容易受到感知干扰和场景语义歧义的影响。本文首次对VLA导航策略的视觉基础定位进行了实证评估。我们提出了一种基于实时分割的视觉基础定位方法，利用SegFormer将可通行区域标为绿色、不可通行区域标为红色。评估了两种变体：仅观测分割与联合观测-目标增强。基于Grand Tour数据集上的OmniVLA模型实验表明，在最远航点处，视觉基础定位根据指令长度不同，可使平均航点误差降低27-44%。长指令相比短指令获益更显著，而视觉基础定位对图像目标的改善效果甚微。归一化误差分析表明，视觉基础定位主要起到轨迹长度正则化作用，可将预测路径长度缩短30%，但未提升单位距离内的推理精度。研究结果表明，视觉基础定位为无需模型重新训练、计算开销低且易于实施的VLA导航改进方法，但无法弥补训练信号在分布外指令中的缺失。

Authors: Adrian Szvoren, Dimitrios Kanoulas, Nilufer Tuptuk

Qantara: Bridge-Flow Training for Multi-Paradigm JEPA Control WorldModel

Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture Brownian-bridge flow matching latent planning behavior cloning inverse dynamics

简要说明：Qantara 提出了一种基于布朗桥流匹配的 JEPA 世界模型训练目标，使得单个检查点无需重新训练即可支持多种推理范式（潜在规划、行为克隆、逆动力学）。

TLDR: Qantara introduces a Brownian-bridge flow matching training objective for JEPA world models, enabling a single checkpoint to serve multiple inference paradigms (latent planning, behavior cloning, inverse dynamics) without retraining.

Abstract: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) underpin a growing family of latent world models for control from raw pixels, but every existing JEPA world model commits at training time to a single inference paradigm: either trajectory optimisation in a learned dynamics model, or direct behaviour cloning. A single checkpoint that serves both would defer this choice to inference, when deployment constraints (rollout cost, observation accessibility) determine which path wins. We present Qantara, an end-to-end JEPA whose joint training objective pairs a Brownian-bridge interpolant between consecutive clean latents on the state axis with noise-to-data flow matching on the action axis. The same checkpoint serves three inference paradigms without retraining: latent planning, behaviour-cloning action sampling, and inverse dynamics, which we query through a video-inverse composition that first predicts the next latent without action conditioning, then extracts the action. Training concentrates mass on the edges of the (action-time, state-time) noise square, where inference queries the predictor: replacing it with uniform interior sampling drops Push-T planning from 90.1 to 53.3 SR at matched compute. On the LeWM control suite, Qantara reaches a 91.2 SR three-train-seed average and sets new SOTA on OGBench-Cube (+7.7 SR over DINO-WM, +19.7 over LeWM). From the same weights, the behaviour-cloning and video-inverse paths reach 82-83 SR on Push-T and 71-73 SR on Cube. These results move JEPA world models from single-paradigm planners to multi-paradigm controllers.

摘要（中文）：联合嵌入预测架构（JEPAs）支撑着越来越多基于原始像素控制的环境潜在世界模型，但现有JEPA世界模型在训练时都固守单一推理范式：要么在习得动力学模型中进行轨迹优化，要么直接进行行为克隆。若能通过单个检查点同时支持两种范式，则可将选择延迟至推理阶段，根据部署约束（展开成本、观测可及性）决定采用哪种路径。我们提出Qantara——一种端到端JEPA，其联合训练目标将状态轴上连续干净潜变量之间的布朗桥插值与动作轴上噪声到数据的流匹配相结合。同一检查点无需重新训练即可支持三种推理范式：潜在规划、行为克隆动作采样和逆动力学——我们通过视频逆合成查询逆动力学：先预测无动作条件约束的下一潜变量，再提取动作。训练时将质量集中于（动作-时间，状态-时间）噪声正方形的边界——这正是推理查询预测器的位置：将其替换为均匀内部采样后，在同等计算量下Push-T规划成功率从90.1%降至53.3%。在LeWM控制套件中，Qantara在三次训练种子平均下达到91.2%的成功率，并在OGBench-Cube上创下新纪录（较DINO-WM提升7.7%，较LeWM提升19.7%）。基于相同权重，行为克隆和视频逆路径在Push-T上达到82-83%成功率，在Cube上达到71-73%。这些成果将JEPA世界模型从单范式规划器拓展为多范式控制器。

Authors: Ruslan Rakhimov, George Bredis, Yuriy Maksyuta, Daniil Gavrilov

Real-World Perturbation Testing of Autonomous Driving Systems AutonomousDriving

perturbation testing autonomous driving real-world evaluation camera LiDAR

简要说明：一项大规模研究，在离线、硬件在环和闭环真实世界测试中评估了72种摄像头和LiDAR干扰，结果表明离线鲁棒性指标不足以预测真实世界故障。

TLDR: A large-scale study evaluating 72 camera and LiDAR perturbations on an autonomous driving system across offline, hardware-in-the-loop, and closed-loop real-world testing, revealing that offline robustness metrics are insufficient to predict real-world failures.

Abstract: Autonomous Driving Systems (ADS) must operate reliably under diverse conditions, yet representative data for rare or adverse scenarios is difficult to obtain. Perturbation-based testing is widely used to assess robustness, but most studies focus on offline datasets or simulation, leaving open questions about how such results translate to real-world driving. We present a large-scale study of 72 camera and LiDAR perturbations, evaluated across three testing modalities: offline model-level analysis, hardware-in-the-loop execution, and closed-loop system-level testing on a full-scale autonomous vehicle. The study covers both an end-to-end vision-based driving model and a modular LiDAR-based perception and planning stack. Our results reveal a clear gap between testing levels. For camera-based systems, perturbations with limited offline impact can still induce unstable control and failures in real-world driving. For LiDAR-based systems, degradation is more consistent at the perception level but weakly predictive of system-level failures. Across both modalities, model-level metrics alone are insufficient to identify the most harmful perturbations. We further show that real-time feasibility is a key constraint in real-world testing, and that robustness observations obtained from recorded data do not consistently transfer to closed-loop behavior on a physical vehicle, highlighting the importance of complementary real-world, system-level evaluation.

摘要（中文）：自主驾驶系统（ADS）必须在多种条件下可靠运行，但针对罕见或恶劣场景的代表性数据难以获取。基于扰动的测试被广泛用于评估鲁棒性，然而多数研究聚焦于离线数据集或仿真环境，导致此类结果如何转化为真实驾驶场景仍存疑问。我们针对72种相机与激光雷达扰动开展大规模研究，在三种测试模式中进行评估：离线模型级分析、硬件在环执行，以及全尺寸自动驾驶车辆的闭环系统级测试。该研究涵盖基于视觉的端到端驾驶模型与基于激光雷达的模块化感知与规划堆栈。结果显示各测试层级间存在显著差异。对于基于相机的系统，离线影响有限的扰动仍可能在真实驾驶中引发控制不稳与失效。对于基于激光雷达的系统，感知层面的退化虽更一致，但对系统级失效的预测能力较弱。两种模式中，仅凭模型级指标均不足以识别最具危害性的扰动。我们进一步证明，实时可行性是真实世界测试的关键约束，且从记录数据中获得的鲁棒性观测结果无法稳定迁移至实车闭环行为，这凸显了补充性真实世界系统级评估的重要性。

Authors: Stefano Carlo Lambertenghi, Matthias Weil, Andrea Stocco

Closing the Reality Gap: Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Deployment for Dexterous Force-Based Grasping and Manipulation Manipulation

sim-to-real dexterous manipulation tactile feedback reinforcement learning zero-shot transfer

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于灵巧手的仿真到现实强化学习框架，结合了触觉仿真、电流-扭矩标定和驱动器动力学随机化，实现了在真实五指手上的可控抓取和手内重定向零样本迁移。

TLDR: This paper presents a sim-to-real RL framework for dexterous hands that combines tactile simulation, current-to-torque calibration, and actuator dynamics randomization to achieve zero-shot transfer of controllable grasping and in-hand reorientation on a real five-finger hand.

Abstract: Human-like dexterous hands with multiple fingers offer human-level manipulation capabilities but remain difficult to train the control policies that can deploy on real hardware due to contact-rich physics and imperfect actuation. We present a sim-to-real reinforcement learning method that leverages dense tactile feedback combined with joint torque sensing to explicitly regulate physical interactions. To enable effective sim-to-real transfer, we introduce (i) a computationally fast tactile simulation that computes distances between dense virtual tactile units and the object via parallel forward kinematics, providing high-rate, high-resolution touch signals needed by RL; (ii) a current-to-torque calibration that eliminates the need for torque sensors on dexterous hands by mapping motor current to joint torque; and (iii) actuator dynamics modeling with randomization to account for non-ideal torque-speed effects and bridge the actuation gaps. Using an asymmetric actor-critic PPO pipeline, we train policies entirely in simulation and deploy them directly to a five-finger hand. The resulting policies demonstrate two essential human-hand skills: (1) command-based controllable grasp force tracking and (2) reorientation of objects in the hand, both of which are robustly executed without fine-tuning on the robot. By combining tactile and torque in the observation space with scalable sensing and actuation modeling, our system provides a practical solution to achieve reliable dexterous manipulation. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of controllable grasping on a multi-finger dexterous hand trained entirely in simulation and transferred zero-shot on real hardware.

摘要（中文）：类人多指灵巧手具备类人水平的操控能力，但由于接触密集的物理特性和不完美的驱动机制，其控制策略在真实硬件上的训练仍面临困难。我们提出一种基于仿真到现实的强化学习方法，利用密集触觉反馈与关节力矩传感相结合的方式，显式调控物理交互过程。为实现有效的仿真到现实迁移，我们引入：(i) 一种计算高效的触觉仿真方法，通过并行正向运动学计算密集虚拟触觉单元与物体之间的距离，为强化学习提供高频率、高分辨率的触觉信号；(ii) 电流-力矩标定方法，通过将电机电流映射为关节力矩，无需在灵巧手上安装力矩传感器；(iii) 含随机化的驱动动力学建模，以考虑非理想力矩-速度效应并弥合驱动差异。采用非对称演员-评论家PPO流程，我们完全在仿真中训练策略并直接部署到五指手上。所得策略展现出两项人类手部核心技能：(1) 基于指令的可控抓取力跟踪；(2) 手内物体重新定向，均无需在机器人上微调即可稳健执行。通过在观测空间中将触觉与力矩传感结合，配合可扩展的传感与驱动建模，本系统为实现可靠灵巧操控提供了实用解决方案。据我们所知，这是首个在完全仿真训练的多指灵巧手上实现可控抓取、并零样本迁移至真实硬件的演示。

Authors: Zhe Zhao, Zhibin Li, Yilin Ou, Mengshi Qi

DSWAM: A Dual-System World Action Foundation Model for Fine-Grained Robot Manipulation VLA

World Action Model Dual-System Fine-Grained Manipulation VLA comparison Subtaks Planning

简要说明：DSWAM 提出了一种双系统架构，将 System-1 世界动作模型执行器与 System-2 VLM 子任务规划器相结合，实现了细粒度操作，并在 DeMaVLA 基准下与 VLA 策略进行了公平的真实机器人对比。

TLDR: DSWAM proposes a dual-system architecture combining a System-1 World Action Model executor with a System-2 VLM subtask planner, enabling fine-grained manipulation while providing a fair real-robot comparison against VLA policies under the DeMaVLA benchmark.

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) provide a promising alternative to Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies by using video-based world modeling as dense supervision for robot action learning. Existing WAMs excel at physically grounded execution, but typically lack the explicit language-level planning interface in VLM-based VLAs for decomposing coarse instructions. Such decomposition becomes important when household tasks involve complex multi-step goals, where coarse user commands need to be converted into sequences of fine-grained executable subtasks. Meanwhile, the field still lacks a fair real-robot comparison between VLA and WAM execution capabilities, since existing systems often differ in data, robot embodiments, and task protocols. To address both the decomposition gap and the need for a controlled WAM-VLA comparison, we introduce DSWAM, a Dual-System World Action Foundation Model for fine-grained robot manipulation. DSWAM keeps a System 1 WAM executor as the default control path and optionally activates a System 2 vision-language subtask planner only when task decomposition is useful. The planner predicts executable subtasks from short-term visual history and a global task prompt, while the WAM executor performs world-aware action generation for each instruction or subtask. The executor is trained with action prediction and video co-training, but inference directly predicts action chunks without explicit future video generation. To make this execution path practical on real robots, we further integrate TensorRT acceleration, asynchronous execution, and real-time chunking (RTC) so that policy queries do not block robot control. To provide a fair real-robot comparison with VLA policies, we build and evaluate DSWAM under the DeMaVLA real-world deformable manipulation setting with matched robot platform, pretraining data, post-training data, and evaluation criteria.

摘要（中文）：世界动作模型（WAM）通过基于视频的世界模型为机器人动作学习提供密集监督，成为视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的一种有前景的替代方案。现有WAM擅长物理基础执行任务，但通常缺乏基于VLM的VLA策略中用于分解粗略指令的显式语言级规划接口。当家庭任务涉及复杂多步骤目标时，这种分解能力变得尤为重要，因为粗粒度的用户指令需要被转化为一系列细粒度的可执行子任务。与此同时，该领域仍缺乏对VLA与WAM执行能力的公平真实机器人比较，因为现有系统在数据、机器人形态和任务协议上往往存在差异。为解决分解能力的不足以及WAM-VLA受控比较的需求，我们提出DSWAM——一种面向细粒度机器人操作的双系统世界动作基础模型。DSWAM将系统1的WAM执行器作为默认控制路径，并仅在任务分解有用时选择性激活系统2的视觉-语言子任务规划器。该规划器根据短期视觉历史及全局任务提示预测可执行子任务，而WAM执行器则针对每条指令或子任务进行具有世界感知能力的动作生成。执行器通过动作预测与视频协同训练进行优化，但推理时直接预测动作片段，无需显式生成未来视频。为使该执行路径在真实机器人上切实可行，我们进一步集成了TensorRT加速、异步执行及实时分块（RTC）技术，以确保策略查询不会阻塞机器人控制。为提供与VLA策略的公平真实机器人比较，我们在DeMaVLA真实世界可变形操作设定下构建并评估DSWAM，采用匹配的机器人平台、预训练数据、后训练数据及评估标准。

Authors: Jian Zhu, Jianjun Zhang, Taiyi Su, Tianbin Liu, Zhangyuan Wang, Kai Xie, Zitai Huang, Chong Ma, Youzhang He, Tianjian Wang, Hanyang Wang, Weihao Ding, Yi Xu

PRISM: Personalized Robotic Dataset Generation via Image-based Scene and Motion Synthesis VLA

vision-language-action dataset generation scene synthesis motion synthesis digital cousin scenes

简要说明：PRISM 通过单张图像和自然语言指令生成个性化机器人训练数据集，利用数字孪生场景和合成演示提升策略泛化能力，无需遥操作。

TLDR: PRISM generates personalized robot training datasets from a single image and natural language instruction, using digital cousin scenes and synthesized demonstrations to improve policy generalization without teleoperation.

Abstract: Recent advances in large-scale pretrained vision-language-action models have improved robot policy learning, but directly deploying such policies in user-specific environments remains challenging due to limited generalization, which inevitably requires collecting a dataset tailored to the target environment. Teleoperation yields well-aligned data but is costly and difficult to scale, whereas simulation scales easily but struggles to resemble the target environment and generate task-specific trajectories. To meet both simultaneously, we propose PRISM, an end-to-end pipeline that generates personalized robotic datasets from a single image and a natural-language instruction. PRISM constructs digital cousin scenes that are semantically and geometrically aligned with the user environment yet diverse at the instance level, and synthesizes executable demonstrations without human teleoperation. Extensive experiments show that policies trained on PRISM-generated datasets outperform those trained on baseline-generated datasets on LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus, achieve up to 100\% success rate on three real-world manipulation tasks, and maintain stronger performance when evaluated in environments that differ from those seen during training.

摘要（中文）：最近在大规模预训练的视觉-语言-动作模型方面的进展改进了机器人策略学习，但由于泛化能力有限，直接将此类策略部署到用户特定环境中仍然具有挑战性，这不可避免地需要收集针对目标环境定制化的数据集。遥操作能够生成对齐良好的数据，但成本高昂且难以扩展；而仿真虽然易于扩展，却难以逼真地模拟目标环境并生成特定任务轨迹。为了同时满足这两个需求，我们提出了PRISM——一种端到端流水线，能够从单张图像和自然语言指令生成个性化机器人数据集。PRISM构建了在语义和几何上与用户环境对齐、但在实例层面上具有多样性的“数字孪生场景”，并在无需人工遥操作的情况下合成可执行的示范轨迹。大量实验表明，基于PRISM生成数据集训练的策略在LIBERO和LIBERO-Plus上优于基于基线数据集训练的策略，在三个真实世界操作任务中实现了高达100%的成功率，并且在评估环境与训练环境不同的情况下仍能保持更强的性能。

Authors: Dogyu Ko, Haneul Kim, Chanyoung Yeo, Dowoon Lee, Taeho Park, Hyoseok Hwang

Athena-WBC: Capability-Aligned Policy Experts for Long-Tail Humanoid Whole-Body Control HumanoidEmbodied

humanoid whole-body control capability-aligned policy experts teacher-student pipeline long-tail motions DAGGER distillation

简要说明：Athena-WBC 通过能力对齐的策略专家解决人形全身控制中的长尾运动失败问题，采用跟踪导向和平衡专家结合教师-学生蒸馏流水线。

TLDR: Athena-WBC introduces capability-aligned policy experts to address long-tail motion failures in humanoid whole-body control, using tracking-focused and balance experts with a teacher-student distillation pipeline.

Abstract: Large-scale humanoid motion-tracking controllers are commonly improved by reallocating training effort: difficult motions are sampled more often, isolated into smaller subsets, or assigned to specialized experts. We show that this view is incomplete. In strong whole-body-control baselines, a residual set of feasible training clips remains unsolved even under targeted training, especially for high-dynamic transitions and balance-critical motions. These failures arise not only from insufficient exposure, but from a mismatch between the motion demands and the effective capability induced by the default training recipe. We propose Athena-WBC, a compact teacher-student pipeline with capability-aligned policy experts for long-tail humanoid whole-body control. Dynamic experts use a tracking-focused, constraint-aware objective that removes conservative effort and temporal-control penalties while preserving physical feasibility constraints; balance experts use a gravity curriculum to improve early-training survivability. The resulting privileged teachers are motion-routed for DAgger distillation and then compressed into a single controller with deployable observations followed by RL fine-tuning. Experiments on a full-size humanoid show improved recovery of training-set long-tail motions and better held-out tracking than a strong SONIC-recipe baseline, using only a small number of experts.

摘要（中文）：大规模人体运动追踪控制器通常通过重新分配训练资源来改进：更频繁地采样困难动作，将其分离为更小的子集，或分配给专门的专家。我们表明，这种观点是不完整的。在强大的全身控制基线中，即使在针对性训练下，仍有一组残余的可行训练片段无法解决，尤其是对于高动态过渡和平衡关键动作。这些失败不仅源于训练暴露不足，更源于运动需求与默认训练方案所诱导的有效能力之间的不匹配。我们提出Athena-WBC，一种紧凑的师生流水线，配备能力对齐的策略专家，用于长尾人体全身控制。动态专家使用面向追踪、考虑约束的目标函数，在保留物理可行性约束的同时，去除了保守性努力和时间控制惩罚；平衡专家则使用重力课程来提升早期训练的可存活率。所得的特权教师通过运动路由进行DAgger蒸馏，随后压缩为具有可部署观测量的单一控制器，并加以强化学习微调。在全尺寸人形机器人上的实验表明，与强大的SONIC方案基线相比，仅使用少量专家，该方法就能改善训练集中长尾动作的恢复，并表现出更好的留出动作追踪性能。

Authors: Yuan Jiang, Ningyuan Zhang, Xicun Yang, Yuzhi Jiang, Jie Chen

CAC-VLA: Context-Gated Action Conditioning for Vision-Language-Action Models VLA

Vision-Language-Action latent-action conditioning context gate robot manipulation LIBERO

简要说明：本文提出CAC-VLA框架，通过在视觉-语言-动作模型中学习潜在动作条件，提升了在LIBERO基准上的操作成功率。

TLDR: This paper proposes CAC-VLA, a framework that enhances Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models by learning latent-action conditioning within the VLM, improving manipulation success rates on LIBERO benchmarks.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have become a promising paradigm for generalist robot manipulation, where visual-language representations are used to condition continuous action generation. However, these representations are not explicitly optimized for action conditioning, leaving the action expert to bridge the gap between multimodal understanding and precise motor control. Recent action-reasoning methods introduce additional modules to generate explicit action plans or action-space reasoning signals, demonstrating the benefit of action-level guidance but often requiring separate action-generation frameworks. We propose CAC-VLA, a Context-Gated Action Conditioning framework that learns a lightweight latent-action interface directly within the VLM. Instead of generating executable trajectories, CAC-VLA trains the VLM to predict coarse-to-fine latent actions, which are structured representations encoded from future action segments, and adaptively leverages them to condition the action expert via a context gate. This enables VLM-native action conditioning while calibrating the influence of latent-action guidance on expert action generation. Experiments on LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus demonstrate the effectiveness of CAC-VLA, achieving 98.3% average success rate on LIBERO and 89.5% LIBERO-Plus, suggesting that context-gated latent-action conditioning is an effective interface for continuous expert control.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已成为通用机器人操作领域颇具前景的范式，其利用视觉-语言表示来约束连续动作的生成。然而，这些表示并未针对动作约束进行显式优化，导致动作专家需在多模态理解与精确运动控制之间架设桥梁。近期动作推理方法引入额外模块生成显式动作规划或动作空间推理信号，证明了动作层级引导的有效性，但通常需要独立的动作生成框架。我们提出CAC-VLA——一种上下文门控动作约束框架，可直接在视觉-语言模型（VLM）内部学习轻量级潜在动作接口。CAC-VLA不生成可执行轨迹，而是训练VLM预测从粗到细的潜在动作（即从未来动作片段编码的结构化表示），并通过上下文门自适应地利用这些表示来约束动作专家。该方法实现了VLM原生的动作约束，同时校准了潜在动作引导对专家动作生成的影响。在LIBERO与LIBERO-Plus上的实验验证了CAC-VLA的有效性，其在LIBERO上达到98.3%的平均成功率，在LIBERO-Plus上达到89.5%，表明上下文门控潜在动作约束是连续专家控制的有效接口。

Authors: Yifu Xiong, Wenhao Yu, Jiaxuan Lin, Bojun Zou, Jiahao Li, Lu Zhang, Yanyong Zhang, Jianmin Ji

Learning 4D Geometric Priors for Inference-Efficient World Action Models WorldModel

World Action Models 4D geometric priors multi-expert co-training robotic manipulation lightweight inference

简要说明：本文提出MECo-WAM，一种多专家协同训练框架，将4D几何先验注入世界动作模型以提升机器人操作性能，并在部署时移除辅助组件从而不增加推理成本。

TLDR: This paper proposes MECo-WAM, a multi-expert co-training framework that injects 4D geometric priors into a World Action Model for robotic manipulation, improving performance without increasing inference cost by removing auxiliary components at deployment.

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) have shown strong potential for robotic manipulation by jointly modeling visual future dynamics and executable action sequences. However, existing video-action co-training methods primarily optimize appearance-oriented video latents, which may insufficiently capture the temporally evolving geometry required for precise manipulation. We propose MECo-WAM, a Multi-Expert Co-Training World Action Model that injects action-relevant 4D geometric priors into video-action representations while preserving the original lightweight inference graph. During training, MECo-WAM combines video and action experts with a lightweight 4D expert supervised by relational targets from a frozen VGGT encoder. Asymmetric expert visibility prevents non-causal shortcuts from auxiliary geometry to action generation. To transfer geometric knowledge into the deployed video-action pathway, we introduce decayed 4D read-mask attention, which provides restricted current-frame geometric guidance early in training and progressively removes this dependency. We further propose action-aware temporal geometric distillation, which aligns within-frame geometric relations and their temporal evolution while emphasizing visual regions most relevant to robot actions. At deployment, all auxiliary 4D components are removed. Experiments on LIBERO (98.2%), RoboTwin 2.0 (92.6%), and challenging real-world manipulation tasks show that MECo-WAM improves manipulation performance without increasing inference cost.

摘要（中文）：世界动作模型（WAMs）通过联合建模视觉未来动态与可执行动作序列，在机器人操作中展现出显著潜力。然而，现有视频-动作联合训练方法主要优化面向外观的视频潜在表征，这可能导致无法充分捕捉精确操作所需的时变几何结构。本文提出MECo-WAM——一种多专家联合训练世界动作模型，该模型在保持原始轻量级推理图结构的同时，将动作相关的四维几何先验注入视频-动作表征。训练过程中，MECo-WAM将视频专家与动作专家结合，并引入轻量级四维专家，该专家通过冻结的VGGT编码器的关系目标进行监督。非对称专家可见性机制可防止辅助几何信息向动作生成提供非因果捷径。为将几何知识迁移至实际部署的视频-动作通路，我们提出衰减式四维读取掩码注意力机制，该机制在训练初期提供受限的当前帧几何引导，并逐步消除这一依赖。此外，我们进一步提出动作感知时序几何蒸馏，该方法在对齐帧内几何关系及其时序演化的同时，强调与机器人动作最相关的视觉区域。实际部署时，所有辅助四维组件均被移除。在LIBERO（98.2%）、RoboTwin 2.0（92.6%）及具有挑战性的真实世界操作任务上的实验表明，MECo-WAM在无需增加推理成本的前提下提升了操作性能。

Authors: Jianjun Zhang, Jian Zhu, Taiyi Su, Chong Ma, Zitai Huang, Yi Xu, Hanli Wang

Geometry-Aware Motion Latents for Learning Robust Manipulation Policies Manipulation

motion latents point cloud prediction robotic manipulation single-view RGB-D geometric reasoning

简要说明：GeoMoLa 通过预测单视角 RGB-D 点云随时间的变化来学习离散运动潜码，无需多视角重建即可实现稳健的操作策略。

TLDR: GeoMoLa learns discrete motion latent codes by predicting point cloud evolution over time from single-view RGB-D, achieving robust manipulation policies without multi-view reconstruction.

Abstract: Learning motion latents for robotic manipulation heavily relies on extracting motion patterns from visual sequences, yet effective action abstractions require understanding three-dimensional geometric transformations. Here, we introduce GeoMoLa (Geometry-Aware Motion Latents), which learns discrete motion latent codes by predicting how point clouds evolve during manipulation rather than reconstructing visual observations. This four-dimensional objective -- spatial geometry changing through time -- forces latent representations to encode actual physical motion rather than appearance patterns. GeoMoLa achieves state-of-the-art performance using only single-view RGB-D input, while existing methods require multi-view reconstruction, succeeding across diverse manipulation benchmarks. Our ablations reveal that geometric prediction is the key to driving performance, quantitatively validating that manipulation depends on spatial understanding. Furthermore, the learned codes exhibit effective motion abstraction: applying them to novel scenes produces physically consistent transformations regardless of visual context. Our real-world experiments also confirm this robustness capability, achieving robust manipulation with minimal demonstrations in cluttered environments where geometric reasoning determines success. Thus, we demonstrate that effective motion latents for robot control can better emerge from understanding motion through its three-dimensional effects rather than pixel-level patterns.

摘要（中文）：学习机器人操作的运动潜变量高度依赖于从视觉序列中提取运动模式，然而有效的动作抽象需要理解三维几何变换。本文提出GeoMoLa（几何感知运动潜变量），通过预测操作过程中点云的演化而非重建视觉观测，学习离散运动潜变量编码。这一四维目标——空间几何随时间变化——迫使潜变量表征编码实际的物理运动而非外观模式。GeoMoLa仅利用单视角RGB-D输入即可实现最先进的性能，而现有方法需要多视角重建，并在多种操作基准测试中取得成功。我们的消融实验表明，几何预测是驱动性能的关键，定量验证了操作依赖于空间理解。此外，所学习的编码展现出有效的运动抽象能力：将其应用于新场景时，无论视觉上下文如何，都能产生物理一致的变换。真实世界实验也证实了这一鲁棒性能力，在几何推理决定成败的杂乱环境中，仅需极少量演示即可实现稳健操作。因此，我们证明，有效的机器人控制运动潜变量更应通过三维效应理解运动，而非像素级模式。

Authors: Yunchao Zhang, Yijia Weng, Ruizhe Liu, Ming Hu, Leonidas Guibas, Yanchao Yang

A Reliable Context-Aware and Temporal Planning Framework for Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

reliable context awareness temporal planning BEV representation quality-gated memory autonomous driving

简要说明：RCT-AD提出了一种可靠的情境感知和时间规划框架，通过质量门控FILO记忆机制显式建模每帧特征质量和时间一致性，提升了摄像头退化下的感知与规划鲁棒性。

TLDR: RCT-AD proposes a reliable context-aware and temporal planning framework for autonomous driving that explicitly models per-frame feature quality and temporal consistency via a quality-gated FILO memory mechanism, improving perception and planning robustness under camera degradation.

Abstract: Safe operation of autonomous vehicles in dense urban traffic depends on perception and planning that remain reliable when onboard sensing is degraded. In real driving conditions, camera observations are frequently corrupted by occlusion, motion blur, illumination change, and sensor noise, and when such degraded observations are aggregated indiscriminately over time, trajectory planning becomes unstable and collision risk rises for both the ego vehicle and surrounding road users. Recent Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) approaches unify perception and planning through a shared spatial representation, but most fuse temporal information across frames without assessing the reliability of the underlying observations. We present a Reliable Context-Aware and Temporal Planning framework for Autonomous Driving (RCT-AD) that explicitly models feature quality and temporal consistency to support safer, more consistent planning. A Reliable Context Awareness module scores per-frame reliability and selectively retains trustworthy features through a quality-gated First-In-Last-Out (FILO) memory mechanism, reconstructing degraded observations from reliable historical context so that corrupted inputs do not destabilize the scene representation. A Temporal Trajectory Planner captures long-term dependencies and multi-agent interactions to produce smoother, safety-aware trajectories, while a joint detection-and-segmentation head injects semantic and motion cues into the shared BEV space to strengthen scene understanding. Experiments on the nuScenes autonomous driving benchmark show that RCT-AD improves perception accuracy, motion prediction, and planning robustness over recent end-to-end baselines, achieving 61.5 nuScenes Detection Score, 52.9 mean Average Precision, and 52.3 mean Intersection over Union, while maintaining competitive computational efficiency suitable for real-time deployment.

摘要（中文）：在密集城市交通中，自动驾驶车辆的安全运行依赖于车载感知降级时仍保持可靠的感知与规划能力。在真实驾驶场景中，摄像头观测常因遮挡、运动模糊、光照变化及传感器噪声而受损。若此类降质观测随时间被不加区分地累积聚合，将导致轨迹规划不稳定，并增加自车及周边道路使用者的碰撞风险。当前鸟瞰视角方法通过共享空间表征统一感知与规划，但多数方法在跨帧融合时序信息时未评估底层观测的可靠性。我们提出面向自动驾驶的可靠上下文感知与时序规划框架（RCT-AD），通过显式建模特征质量与时间一致性，实现更安全、更一致的规划。该框架包含：可靠上下文感知模块通过质量门控的先进先出/后进先出混合存储机制逐帧评估可靠度并选择性保留可信特征，从可靠历史上下文中重建降质观测，避免受损输入破坏场景表征；时序轨迹规划器捕获长时依赖与多智能体交互以生成更平滑且具安全意识的轨迹；联合检测-分割头在共享鸟瞰视角空间中注入语义与运动线索以强化场景理解。在nuScenes自动驾驶基准测试中，RCT-AD相较于近期端到端基线方法在感知精度、运动预测及规划鲁棒性上均获得提升，分别达到61.5的nuScenes检测分数、52.9的平均精度均值及52.3的平均交并比，同时保持适于实时部署的竞争性计算效率。

Authors: Argho Dey, Yunfei Yin, Swachha Ray, Md Minhazul Islam, Zheng Yuan, Sijing Xiong, Hongyu Liu, Zhiqiu Huang

KAM-WM: Kinematic Affordance Maps from Latent World Models for Robot Manipulation Manipulation

Kinematic Affordance Map latent world model video prior diffusion policy few-shot manipulation

简要说明：KAM-WM 从冻结的潜视频世界模型中提取运动学可供性图（方向性交互线索），并用于条件化扩散策略，在 LIBERO 和 RoboTwin2.0 基准上实现了出色的少样本操作结果。

TLDR: KAM-WM extracts a kinematic affordance map (directional interaction cue) from a frozen latent video world model and uses it to condition a diffusion policy, achieving strong few-shot manipulation results on LIBERO and RoboTwin2.0 benchmarks.

Abstract: Learning manipulation from few demonstrations requires visual priors that capture not only where to interact, but also how the interaction should begin; static priors such as segmentation masks encode only the former. We present KAM-WM, a framework that extracts a coarse directional interaction cue from a frozen latent video world model without rollout or world-model fine-tuning. KAM-WM queries a Flow Matching image-to-video backbone once and interprets its single-step latent velocity as a Kinematic Affordance Map (KAM), which provides task-conditioned interaction regions and coarse motion structure. A lightweight Perceiver compresses KAM into tokens that condition a diffusion policy together with RGB observations and proprioception. Across LIBERO and RoboTwin2.0, KAM-WM reaches 90.6% average success on LIBERO and achieves 65.7% and 22.4% success rates in the Easy and Hard settings on RoboTwin2.0, respectively. Controlled comparisons against a zero-order mask prior suggest that part of the gains comes from directional information beyond spatial localization alone. These results indicate that, in the evaluated settings, a frozen video model can provide a useful first-order visual prior for control without the test-time cost of future rollout.

摘要（中文）：从少量示范中学习操作技能需要视觉先验知识，这类知识不仅要编码交互位置，还需明确交互如何开始；而分割掩码等静态先验仅涵盖前者。我们提出KAM-WM框架，该框架无需轨迹生成或世界模型微调，即可从冻结的潜在视频世界模型中提取粗粒度的方向性交互线索。KAM-WM对Flow Matching图像到视频主干网络进行一次查询，并将其单步潜在速度解译为运动学可交互性地图（KAM），该地图提供任务条件化的交互区域与粗粒度运动结构。轻量级Perceiver将KAM压缩为令牌，与RGB观测及本体感知信息共同构成扩散策略的条件化输入。在LIBERO与RoboTwin2.0基准测试中，KAM-WM在LIBERO上达到90.6%的平均成功率，在RoboTwin2.0的Easy和Hard设置中分别获得65.7%和22.4%的成功率。与零阶掩码先验的对照实验表明，部分性能提升源自超越空间定位的方向信息。这些结果表明，在评估设定下，冻结视频模型无需未来轨迹生成的测试时开销，即可为控制提供有效的一阶视觉先验。

Authors: Xinyu Shao, Keru Zhou, Guowei Huang, Yajun Gao, Tongtong Cao, Xiu Li

SILO: Simulation-in-the-Loop Sim-to-Real Transfer for Multi-Stage Cable Routing Manipulation

sim-to-real reinforcement learning cable routing deformable manipulation GPU-parallelized simulation

简要说明：该工作提出了一种用于多阶段电缆布线的仿真到现实强化学习框架，利用GPU并行仿真和循环内仿真执行策略，实现了更成功率的真实世界转移和更短的周期时间。

TLDR: This work presents a sim-to-real reinforcement learning framework for multi-stage cable routing, leveraging GPU-parallelized simulation and a Simulation-in-the-Loop (SILO) execution strategy to achieve successful real-world transfer with higher success rates and faster cycle times.

Abstract: Linear-deformable manipulation remains challenging due to the complex deformations of objects such as cables and ropes. Prior data-driven approaches, particularly imitation learning, have shown some promise in narrowly defined settings but typically require thousands of demonstrations for specific tasks and cable types, limiting scalability and generalization. We introduce a sim-to-real reinforcement learning (RL) framework for multi-stage cable routing that leverages GPU-parallelized simulation to approximate linear deformable behaviors. Training across thousands of parallel simulations enables the learned policies to generalize across diverse cable geometries and deformation patterns. To bridge the sim-to-real gap, we propose a novel deployment strategy that combines a Simulation In the LOop (SILO) execution framework, localized RL policies, and robust cable state estimation. On real-world cable routing tasks, our approach achieves higher success rates and 2x reduction in cycle times compared to prior state-of-the-art learning methods. To our knowledge, this is the first successful sim-to-real transfer of RL policies for multi-stage cable routing. Videos and additional visualizations are available at https://silo-cable-routing.github.io/

摘要（中文）：线性可变形物体的操控仍具挑战性，例如电缆和绳索这类物体因其复杂形变难以处理。以往的数据驱动方法，尤其是模仿学习，在特定有限场景下展现出一定潜力，但通常需要针对具体任务和电缆类型提供数千次示范，限制了可扩展性与泛化能力。我们提出一种面向多阶段电缆布线的仿真到现实（sim-to-real）强化学习框架，该框架利用GPU并行化仿真来近似线性可变形行为。通过在上千个并行仿真环境中训练，所学策略能够泛化至多种电缆几何构型与变形模式。为弥合仿真与现实之间的差距，我们提出一种新颖的部署策略，融合了环内仿真（SILO）执行框架、局部化强化学习策略以及鲁棒的电缆状态估计。在真实世界的电缆布线任务中，我们的方法相较此前最先进的学习方法实现了更高成功率，并将周期时间缩短至原来的二分之一。据我们所知，这是首次成功实现多阶段电缆布线任务中强化学习策略的仿真到现实迁移。相关视频及更多可视化内容请访问 https://silo-cable-routing.github.io/。

Authors: Stone Tao, Jie Xu, Hesam Rabeti, Yashraj Narang, Yijie Guo, Iretiayo Akinola

Simple-to-Complex Structured Demonstrations for Vision-Language-Action Learning VLA

simple-to-complex demonstration demonstration organization VLA learning robotic manipulation long-horizon tasks

简要说明：本文提出了一种从简单到复杂的结构化演示收集策略，用于视觉-语言-动作学习，通过分解任务、标准化环境和逐步增加复杂度来系统组织数据，以提高策略学习效率和泛化能力，并在积木分拣和毛巾折叠任务上验证了效果。

TLDR: This paper introduces a simple-to-complex structured demonstration collection strategy for Vision-Language-Action learning, systematically organizing data by decomposing tasks, standardizing environments, and increasing complexity to improve policy learning efficiency and generalization, validated on block sorting and towel folding tasks.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong capabilities in robotic manipulation by integrating visual perception, language understanding, and robot action generation. Existing research has primarily focused on improving model architectures, training strategies, and dataset scale, while little attention has been paid to how demonstrations are collected and organized. We identify demonstration organization as a fundamental yet overlooked aspect of imitation learning, as it directly affects policy learning efficiency, training stability, and policy generalization. To address this gap, we propose a simple-to-complex structured demonstration collection strategy for VLA learning using a dual-arm robotic platform. Our approach systematically organizes data through three general principles: (i) decomposing complex manipulation tasks into progressively learnable sub-skills, (ii) standardizing the interaction environment to reduce unnecessary variability, and (iii) organizing demonstrations according to progressively increasing task complexity. This structured design enables VLA models to first acquire fundamental manipulation skills before learning increasingly complex task compositions, facilitating more effective learning of long-horizon manipulation tasks. We evaluate the proposed strategy on two representative robotic manipulation tasks: block grasping and sorting, and towel folding. Experimental results show consistent improvements in task success rate and training stability compared with the baseline method of directly collecting end-to-end complete task trajectories. These findings highlight demonstration organization as a previously underexplored but important factor in VLA learning and provide practical insights into efficient skill acquisition, scalable dataset construction, and long-horizon robotic manipulation.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过整合视觉感知、语言理解和机器人动作生成，在机器人操作任务中展现出了强大能力。现有研究主要聚焦于改进模型架构、训练策略和数据集规模，却鲜有关注演示数据的采集与组织方式。我们指出，演示数据的组织是模仿学习中一个基础但被忽视的环节，因为它直接影响策略学习效率、训练稳定性以及策略泛化能力。为弥补这一不足，我们提出了一种基于双臂机器人平台的由简到繁的结构化演示采集策略。该方法通过三条通用原则系统化组织数据：（i）将复杂操作任务分解为渐进可学的子技能，（ii）标准化交互环境以减少不必要的变异性，（iii）按照任务复杂度递增的方式组织演示数据。这种结构化设计使VLA模型能够先习得基础操作技能，再逐步学习更复杂的任务组合，从而更高效地掌握长时域操作任务。我们在两种代表性机器人操作任务上评估了所提策略：积木抓取与分类、毛巾折叠。实验结果表明，与直接采集端到端完整任务轨迹的基线方法相比，该方法在任务成功率和训练稳定性上均取得了一致性提升。这些发现揭示了演示数据组织是VLA学习中此前未被充分探索但至关重要的因素，并为高效技能获取、可扩展数据集构建以及长时域机器人操作提供了实践性见解。

Authors: Xinchuan Qiu, Yi Yu

CRISP: A Spatiotemporal Camera-Radar Backbone for Driving via Forecasting-Based World-Model Pretraining AutonomousDriving

camera-radar fusion BEV representation forecasting-based pretraining world model autonomous driving

简要说明：CRISP 通过预测未来激光雷达点云来预训练视觉-雷达融合的BEV骨干网络，在推理时仅使用相机和雷达即可在多种驾驶任务上取得优异表现。

TLDR: CRISP pretrains a camera-radar BEV backbone by forecasting future LiDAR point clouds, enabling strong downstream driving task performance with only camera and radar at inference.

Abstract: Camera-radar (CR) fusion is a practical sensing configuration for autonomous driving, but existing models are typically trained with task-specific supervision, limiting reusable representation learning. We present CRISP, a spatiotemporal CR backbone pretrained through forecasting-based representation learning. Given historical multi-view images and radar sweeps, CRISP learns a unified bird's-eye-view (BEV) representation by predicting future LiDAR point clouds. LiDAR is used only as privileged supervision during pretraining; the deployed model requires only camera and radar. To make forecasting-based pretraining effective for CR fusion, CRISP introduces an enhanced radar encoder, radar-enhanced temporal self-attention, and multimodal feature rendering with modality innovation gating. These components inject radar range and Doppler cues into BEV temporal propagation and allow BEV tokens to selectively incorporate camera and radar evidence. Experiments on nuScenes show that CRISP improves long-horizon point cloud forecasting and transfers effectively to downstream tasks, including 3D detection, tracking, online mapping, motion forecasting, future occupancy prediction, and planning, suggesting that predictive CR pretraining is a promising path toward scalable driving representations under practical sensor configurations. The project website is https://umfieldrobotics.github.io/CRISP.

摘要（中文）：相机-雷达（CR）融合是自动驾驶中一种实用的感知配置，但现有模型通常采用特定任务的监督方式进行训练，限制了可复用的表示学习。我们提出CRISP——一种基于预测式表示学习的时空CR骨干网络预训练方法。给定历史多视图图像与雷达扫描数据，CRISP通过学习预测未来的激光雷达点云，获得统一鸟瞰视角（BEV）表示。激光雷达仅在预训练阶段作为特权监督信号使用；部署模型仅需摄像头与雷达。为使基于预测的预训练有效适配CR融合，CRISP引入了增强型雷达编码器、雷达增强时域自注意力机制，以及基于模态创新门控的多模态特征渲染模块。这些组件将雷达的测距与多普勒线索注入BEV时域传播过程，并允许BEV令牌有选择地融合摄像头与雷达特征。在nuScenes上的实验表明，CRISP不仅提升了长时序点云预测性能，还可有效迁移至三维检测、跟踪、在线地图构建、运动预测、未来占用预测及规划等下游任务，表明基于预测的CR预训练是在实际传感器配置下实现可扩展驾驶表示的一条有前景的路径。项目网站为：https://umfieldrobotics.github.io/CRISP。

Authors: Jingyu Song, Yi Liu, Katherine A. Skinner

VLA Grounder: Language-Conditioning Space Optimization for Black-Box VLA Models VLA

language-conditioning optimization reinforcement learning frozen VLA policy instruction grounding robot foundation model

简要说明：本文提出通过强化学习优化冻结的VLA模型的语言条件输入，在不更新动作权重的情况下提高任务成功率。

TLDR: This paper proposes a method to optimize the language conditioning input of frozen VLA models via reinforcement learning, improving task success without updating action weights.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are commonly treated as end-to-end action policies conditioned on natural-language task descriptions. In practice, however, their behavior often depends sharply on how the instruction is phrased, suggesting that language is not merely a task label but an optimizable conditioning input. We study whether frozen VLA policies can be improved by optimizing language space rather than updating action weights. Our method introduces a language-conditioning space policy that translates a human instruction into a short VLA-grounded command using object appearance, spatial relations, and target-grounding cues. The language-conditioning space policy is initialized with a failure-derived command-space prior and optimized with reinforcement learning from sparse task-completion rewards, while the downstream VLA remains fully frozen. This yields language-conditioning space optimization: RL discovers which VLA-grounded commands best elicit successful behavior from the frozen action policy. Experiments on RL4VLA and VL-Think show that language-conditioning space optimization improves success on instruction-sensitive, symbolic, and multi-object manipulation tasks, demonstrating that language can serve as an optimizable variable for a robot foundation models. Website: https://tttonyalpha.github.io/vla_grounder

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通常被视为以自然语言任务描述为条件的端到端动作策略。然而在实际应用中，其行为往往高度依赖于指令的措辞方式，这表明语言不仅是任务标签，更是一种可优化的条件输入。本研究探讨了是否可以通过优化语言空间而非更新动作权重来改进冻结的VLA策略。我们提出了一种语言条件空间策略，该策略利用物体外观、空间关系和目标锚定线索，将人类指令转化为简短的VLA锚定指令。该语言条件空间策略通过失败衍生的指令空间先验进行初始化，并利用稀疏任务完成奖励进行强化学习优化，同时下游VLA保持完全冻结。由此实现语言条件空间优化：强化学习能够发现哪些VLA锚定指令能最有效地从冻结动作策略中引发成功行为。在RL4VLA和VL-Think上的实验表明，语言条件空间优化可提升指令敏感型、符号型及多物体操作任务的成功率，证实了语言可作为机器人基础模型的可优化变量。网站：https://tttonyalpha.github.io/vla_grounder

Authors: Damir Shodiev, Aleksei Staroverov, Nikita Kachaev, Alexey K. Kovalev, Aleksandr I. Panov

UNIVERSE: Unified Video Action Models for Autonomous Driving with Flexible Mask-Modulated Modality Generation AutonomousDriving

World Action Models Diffusion Transformer mask-modulated modality generation trajectory generation zero-shot transfer

简要说明：UNIVERSE提出了一种统一的扩散Transformer，在自动驾驶中联合训练未来视频潜变量和自车轨迹令牌，通过模态解耦可见性掩码防止目标泄露，并实现高效的仅轨迹推理。

TLDR: UNIVERSE proposes a unified Diffusion Transformer that co-trains future video latents and ego-trajectory tokens for autonomous driving, using a Modality-Decoupling Visibility Mask to prevent target leakage and enable efficient trajectory-only inference.

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) have shown strong potential for improving action generalization in autonomous driving by using future video prediction as dense supervision for scene dynamics and temporal causality. However, it remains unclear which architecture better transfers video-modeling benefits to trajectory generation. Existing cascaded or dual-DiT designs separate video imagination from action prediction, weakening the transfer of video-learned world dynamics to the trajectory branch: the action model may still overfit dataset-specific driving priors, while the video model only indirectly regularizes planning. We propose UNIVERSE, a unified video-action model built upon a single mask-modulated Diffusion Transformer. By co-training future video latents and ego-trajectory tokens within shared generative parameters, UNIVERSE allows dense video supervision to directly shape trajectory denoising, leading to stronger cross-domain action generalization. To ensure causal validity and efficient deployment, we introduce a Modality-Decoupling Visibility Mask, which shares historical context across modalities while blocking mutual attention between future video and trajectory tokens. This prevents future-target leakage and enables trajectory-only inference by removing future-video denoising at test time, achieving a $4.3\times$ speedup over joint video-action rollout while maintaining comparable planning accuracy. The same model also supports video-only and joint video-action rollouts. Experiments show that UNIVERSE achieves 91.0 PDMS on NAVSIM (vs. 89.6 for the Two-DiT variant), and demonstrates strong zero-shot transfer to nuScenes and Bench2Drive without fine-tuning, while ablations confirm the importance of single-DiT unification, video co-training, and mask-based modality decoupling.

摘要（中文）：**摘要：** 世界行动模型通过利用未来视频预测作为场景动态和时间因果性的密集监督，在提升自动驾驶行动泛化能力方面展现出巨大潜力。然而，何种架构能更有效地将视频建模优势迁移至轨迹生成仍不明确。现有的级联或双DiT设计将视频想象与行动预测分离，削弱了视频学习到的世界动态向轨迹分支的迁移：行动模型可能仍过度拟合数据集特定的驾驶先验，而视频模型仅间接规范规划过程。我们提出UNIVERSE——一种基于单一掩码调制扩散Transformer的统一视频-行动模型。通过在共享生成参数内联合训练未来视频潜在表征与自车轨迹令牌，UNIVERSE使密集视频监督能够直接塑造轨迹去噪过程，从而获得更强的跨域行动泛化能力。为确保因果有效性与高效部署，我们引入模态解耦可见性掩码，该掩码在跨模态间共享历史上下文的同时，阻断未来视频令牌与轨迹令牌之间的相互注意力。这既防止了未来目标信息泄露，又能在测试阶段通过移除未来视频去噪实现仅轨迹推理，相比联合视频-行动推演取得4.3倍加速，同时保持相当的规划精度。同一模型还支持仅视频模式及联合视频-行动推演。实验表明，UNIVERSE在NAVSIM上达到91.0 PDMS（双DiT变体为89.6），并在无需微调的情况下展现出对nuScenes和Bench2Drive的强零样本迁移能力；消融实验证实了单DiT统一架构、视频联合训练以及基于掩码的模态解耦的重要性。

Authors: Mengmeng Liu, Diankun Zhang, Jiuming Liu, Jianfeng Cui, Hongwei Xie, Guang Chen, Hangjun Ye, Francesco Nex, Hao Cheng, Michael Ying Yang

TGRIP: A Text-Guided Approach to Vehicle Instance Prediction in Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

Bird's-Eye View instance prediction vision-language model semantic enrichment end-to-end driving

简要说明：TGRIP 通过视觉语言基础模型向 BEV 实例预测注入语义先验，利用教师-学生管道生成密集语义 BEV 图作为辅助监督。

TLDR: TGRIP injects semantic priors from vision-language foundation models into BEV instance prediction for autonomous driving, using a teacher-student pipeline to generate dense semantic BEV maps as auxiliary supervision.

Abstract: Bird's-Eye View (BEV) end-to-end instance prediction has emerged as a robust paradigm for autonomous driving perception, effectively mitigating the error propagation inherent in traditional modular pipelines. However, current state-of-the-art approaches rely predominantly on geometric supervision, such as occupancy regression and optical flow, effectively treating scene agents as generic moving obstacles. This absence of explicit semantic awareness imposes limitations on the capacity of the model to solve ambiguities in complex scenarios, particularly those where object-specific behavior is essential for accurate forecasting (e.g. overtaking, intersections). In this paper, we introduce Text-Guided Representation for Instance Prediction (TGRIP), a novel framework that bridges this gap by injecting rich semantic priors into the instance prediction loop. The proposed teacher-student pipeline employs Vision-Language Foundation Models to generate dense, semantic-enhanced BEV maps from multi-camera images. These maps serve as auxiliary supervision during training, guiding the network to learn spatio-temporal representations that are not only geometrically consistent but also semantically discriminative. To the best of our knowledge, this represents the first attempt to unify semantic guidance with the temporal task of future instance prediction. The experimental results demonstrate that TGRIP surpasses existing state-of-the-art models in nuScenes, validating the hypothesis that semantic enrichment is a fundamental element for robust, end-to-end motion prediction. Code is available on https://github.com/miguelag99/TGRIP.

摘要（中文）：鸟瞰视角端到端实例预测已成为自动驾驶感知领域的一种稳健范式，有效缓解了传统模块化流水线中固有的误差传播问题。然而，当前最先进的方法主要依赖几何监督（如占据回归与光流），实际上将场景中的智能体视为通用移动障碍物。这种显式语义感知的缺失限制了模型在复杂场景中消除歧义的能力，尤其是在需要基于对象特定行为进行精确预测的场景中（例如超车、交叉路口）。本文提出文本引导的实例预测表示框架（TGRIP），通过将丰富的语义先验注入实例预测循环，填补了这一空白。所提出的师生流水线利用视觉-语言基础模型，从多摄像头图像生成密集的语义增强鸟瞰图。这些图在训练期间作为辅助监督信号，引导网络学习既满足几何一致性又具备语义判别性的时空表征。据我们所知，这是首次将语义引导与未来实例预测的时间任务统一起来的尝试。实验结果表明，TGRIP在nuScenes数据集上超越了现有最先进模型，验证了语义增强是实现稳健端到端运动预测的基本要素。代码开源地址：https://github.com/miguelag99/TGRIP。

Authors: Miguel Antunes-García, Santiago Montiel-Marín, Fabio Sánchez-García, Rodrigo Gutiérrez-Moreno, Rafael Barea, Luis M. Bergasa

SparseOcc++: Geometry-Aware Sparse Latent Representation for Semantic Occupancy Prediction AutonomousDriving

semantic occupancy prediction sparse representation scene completion signed-distance field autonomous driving

简要说明：SparseOcc++ 提出了一种几何感知的稀疏框架，用于自动驾驶中的3D语义占据预测，通过符号距离回归将场景补全与语义分割解耦，实现了最先进的精度和速度提升。

TLDR: SparseOcc++ introduces a geometry-aware sparse framework for 3D semantic occupancy prediction in autonomous driving, decoupling scene completion from semantic segmentation via signed-distance regression and achieving state-of-the-art speed and accuracy.

Abstract: Vision-based 3D semantic occupancy prediction is essential for autonomous driving, yet dense voxel representations waste computation on largely empty space, while BEV and TPV projections compromise fine-grained 3D structure. Fully sparse representations offer an attractive alternative, but existing methods, including SparseOcc, entangle scene completion with semantic prediction by indiscriminately propagating high-dimensional features into empty regions and applying voxel-wise classification. This creates excessive activations, computational overhead, and geometric ambiguity. We present SparseOcc++, a geometry-aware sparse framework that explicitly decouples scene completion from semantic segmentation. SparseOcc++ reformulates completion as signed-distance regression on sparse anchor voxels through a scene completion field (SCF). To model complex outdoor geometry robustly, it combines orthogonal decomposition with discretized distance learning. A geometry-guided propagation module then converts the SCF into a complete volumetric scene and restricts semantic segmentation to geometrically verified regions. Experiments establish new state of the art: SparseOcc++ improves IoU by 2.3 points and is 3.9x faster than SparseOcc on nuScenes, while achieving a 5.9x speedup over OccFormer on SemanticKITTI.

摘要（中文）：基于视觉的3D语义占据预测对于自动驾驶至关重要，然而密集体素表示在大部分空域上浪费计算资源，而BEV和TPV投影则损害了细粒度的3D结构。全稀疏表示提供了一种有吸引力的替代方案，但现有方法（包括SparseOcc）通过无差别地将高维特征传播到空域并应用逐体素分类，使得场景补全与语义预测相互纠缠。这导致了过多的激活、计算开销以及几何歧义。我们提出SparseOcc++，一种几何感知的稀疏框架，显式地将场景补全与语义分割解耦。SparseOcc++将补全重构为通过场景补全场（SCF）对稀疏锚定体素进行的符号距离回归。为了稳健地建模复杂的室外几何结构，它将正交分解与离散距离学习相结合。随后，一个几何引导的传播模块将SCF转化为完整的体素场景，并将语义分割限制在几何验证的区域。实验确立了新的最先进水平：在nuScenes上，SparseOcc++将IoU提升了2.3个百分点，且速度是SparseOcc的3.9倍；在SemanticKITTI上，其速度是OccFormer的5.9倍。

Authors: Pin Tang, Zhongdao Wang, Guoqing Wang, Xiangxuan Ren, Chao Ma

PixelPilot: Scalable Vision-Language-Action Models for End-to-End Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

Vision-Language-Action Models end-to-end autonomous driving decoupled planning 2D-to-2D trajectory prediction Group Relative Policy Optimization

简要说明：PixelPilot 提出了一种解耦规划与提升的 VLA 自动驾驶方法，将轨迹预测重构为与传感器无关的 2D 任务，提升了数据可扩展性和视觉推理能力，在开环和闭环场景中均达到最优性能。

TLDR: PixelPilot proposes a decoupled planning-and-lifting VLA for autonomous driving, reformulating trajectory prediction as a sensor-agnostic 2D task to improve data scalability and visual reasoning, achieving state-of-the-art open/closed-loop performance.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action Models (VLAs), which leverage the advanced reasoning capabilities of Vision-Language Models (VLMs), show promising generalization in complex autonomous driving scenarios. Existing VLAs typically predict and optimize 3D trajectories from 2D images. While intuitive, this 2D-to-3D prediction is inherently entangled with camera parameters, leading to limited data scalability across heterogeneous driving datasets. Moreover, directly optimizing in 3D space induces severe convergence to trivial solutions, where VLAs rely on ego-status rather than visual scene understanding. To address these issues, we propose PixelPilot, a novel VLA featuring a decoupled planning and lifting paradigm. In the planning phase, PixelPilot reformulates scene understanding and trajectory prediction as sensor-agnostic 2D-to-2D tasks in the image plane, thereby facilitating scalable training across diverse datasets. The planned 2D trajectories are then deterministically lifted to 3D only during inference, ensuring the full exploitation of visual cues and generalization across different vehicles. To realize this paradigm, we propose a knowledge-instilled policy learning strategy that applies dense, intermediate rewards via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to enforce a rigorous causal chain from visual perception to spatial planning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PixelPilot achieves state-of-the-art performance in both open-loop and closed-loop settings, validating its superior scalability and visual reasoning capabilities.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作模型（Vision-Language-Action Models, VLAs）利用视觉-语言模型（Vision-Language Models, VLMs）的高级推理能力，在复杂自动驾驶场景中展现出良好的泛化性能。现有VLA通常从二维图像预测并优化三维轨迹。尽管直观，但这种二维到三维的预测本质上与相机参数耦合，导致在不同异构驾驶数据集上的数据可扩展性受限。此外，直接在三维空间进行优化会严重收敛至琐碎解，使VLA依赖自车状态而非视觉场景理解。为解决上述问题，我们提出PixelPilot，一种采用解耦规划与提升范式的新型VLA。在规划阶段，PixelPilot将场景理解与轨迹预测重构为图像平面上与传感器无关的二维到二维任务，从而促进跨数据集的规模化训练。规划完成的二维轨迹仅在推理阶段通过确定性提升算法映射至三维空间，确保视觉线索的充分利用及跨车辆泛化能力。为实现该范式，我们提出知识注入策略学习机制，通过组相对策略优化（Group Relative Policy Optimization, GRPO）施加密集的中间奖励，强制构建从视觉感知到空间规划的严格因果链。大量实验证明，PixelPilot在开环与闭环场景中均达到最优性能，验证了其卓越的可扩展性与视觉推理能力。

Authors: Pin Tang, Guoqing Wang, Xiangxuan Ren, Zhongdao Wang, Guodongfang Zhao, Bailan, Chao Ma

Geographic Diversity Beats Data Volume for Cross-Domain Generalization in Zero-Label JEPA Driving World Models AutonomousDriving

JEPA world model cross-domain generalization geographic diversity zero-shot transfer driving scenarios

简要说明：本文表明，在地理多样性数据（多个城市）上训练基于JEPA的驾驶世界模型，比在更大规模的单城市数据上训练，能更好地零样本泛化到未见城市，说明多样性优于数据量。

TLDR: This paper shows that training a JEPA-based driving world model on geographically diverse data (multiple cities) yields better zero-shot generalization to unseen cities than training on larger volumes of single-geography data, suggesting diversity beats data volume for cross-domain generalization.

Abstract: Self-supervised latent world models can assign a surprise score to driving scenarios without any human labels. A natural follow-up question is whether such a model, trained on driving data from one geographic region, can generalize its notion of complexity to unseen cities and sensor configurations. We study this question through a controlled transfer experiment: we train JEPA-based world models on nuPlan data (Pittsburgh, Boston, Singapore) and evaluate zero-shot on held-out Argoverse 2 validation scenarios from Miami and Austin. We find that models trained on geographically diverse data generalize significantly better than models trained on equal amounts of single-geography data. In a matched-scale ablation at 63,000 scenarios per condition (n=3 seeds each), combined training reduces mean surprise score by 16.5% relative to nuPlan-only training (0.228 +/- 0.015 vs 0.273 +/- 0.008). Notably, training on 200,000 AV2-only scenarios (3x more data from one geography) still produces higher surprise (0.264) than the combined 63K model, suggesting that geographic diversity is a stronger predictor of cross-domain generalization than raw data volume.

摘要（中文）：基于自监督学习的潜在世界模型能够在无需任何人工标注的情况下，为驾驶场景分配一个惊奇评分。一个自然延伸的问题是，这种在某一地理区域驾驶数据上训练的模型，能否将其对场景复杂性的理解泛化至未见过的城市及传感器配置。我们通过一项受控迁移实验探究该问题：在nuPlan数据集（匹兹堡、波士顿、新加坡）上训练基于JEPA的世界模型，并零样本评估来自迈阿密和奥斯汀的保留Argoverse 2验证场景。研究发现，在地理多样性数据上训练的模型，其泛化能力显著优于在等量单一地理数据上训练的模型。在每种条件63,000个场景的匹配规模消融实验（每组3个随机种子）中，联合训练相比仅使用nuPlan训练，平均惊奇评分降低了16.5%（0.228±0.015对比0.273±0.008）。值得注意的是，使用200,000个AV2单独场景（来自单一地理区域的3倍数据量）训练产生的惊奇评分（0.264）仍高于联合训练的63K模型，这表明地理多样性相比原始数据量是跨域泛化更强的预测指标。

Authors: Santosh Jaiswal

CCFM: Collision-Constrained Flow Matching for Safety-Critical Scenario Generation AutonomousDriving

collision-constrained flow matching safety-critical scenario generation autonomous vehicle evaluation hard physical constraints closed-loop simulation

简要说明：CCFM 提出了一种碰撞约束流匹配框架，通过硬物理约束生成可控的安全关键场景，用于自动驾驶闭环评估，在保持行为真实性的同时实现了高碰撞率。

TLDR: CCFM introduces a collision-constrained flow matching framework that enforces hard physical constraints to generate controllable, safety-critical scenarios for closed-loop AV evaluation, achieving high collision rates with realistic behavior.

Abstract: Evaluation of autonomous vehicle (AV) planners in safety-critical closed-loop simulation is essential for real-world deployment. However, generating controllable safety-critical scenarios remains challenging. Existing approaches use soft guidance that provides only probabilistic preferences and cannot guarantee the satisfaction of geometric and severity constraints associated with specific collision types. We introduce Collision-Constrained Flow Matching (CCFM), a novel framework that guarantees precise collision control through hard physical constraints. CCFM consists of three key components: (i) a heuristic collision selector that optimally identifies an adversarial agent and collision type via composite scoring; (ii) structured hard constraints that explicitly define four collision types (rear-end, side, cut-in, head-on) through contact point, heading, and severity requirements; and (iii) a collision-constrained flow matching sampler that enforces the constraints via Gauss-Newton manifold projection. CCFM achieves collision rate up to 46.4% on nuScenes and 83.1% on nuPlan, significantly outperforming baselines while preserving realistic driving behavior. By enabling controllable collision characteristics in safety-critical scenario generation, CCFM provides a reliable foundation for AV safety evaluation and sim-to-real crash data generation. The code and implementation details are available at https://github.com/KELISBU/CCFM.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 在安全关键的闭环仿真中评估自动驾驶车辆规划器对于实际部署至关重要。然而，生成可控的安全关键场景仍具挑战性。现有方法采用软引导，仅提供概率性偏好，无法保证满足特定碰撞类型所涉及的几何与严重性约束。我们提出碰撞约束流匹配（CCFM），一种通过硬物理约束确保精确碰撞控制的新型框架。CCFM包含三个关键组成部分：(i) 启发式碰撞选择器，通过综合评分最优识别对抗性智能体与碰撞类型；(ii) 结构化硬约束，通过接触点、航向和严重性要求明确定义四种碰撞类型（追尾、侧碰、切入、正面碰撞）；(iii) 碰撞约束流匹配采样器，通过高斯-牛顿流形投影强制执行约束。CCFM在nuScenes上达到46.4%的碰撞率，在nuPlan上达到83.1%，显著优于基线方法，同时保持逼真的驾驶行为。通过在安全关键场景生成中实现可控的碰撞特征，CCFM为自动驾驶安全评估及从仿真到现实的碰撞数据生成提供了可靠基础。代码和实现细节见 https://github.com/KELISBU/CCFM。
