Authors: Ke Li, Kaidi Liang, Yuxin Ding, Debojyoti Biswas, Xianbiao Hu, Ruwen Qin

LLM-as-a-Verifier: A General-Purpose Verification Framework RLRobot

verification fine-grained feedback continuous scores agentic tasks robotics reward

简要说明：LLM-as-a-Verifier 提出一种概率验证框架，通过计算 LLM 词元 logits 的期望生成连续分数来评估解决方案正确性，在 RoboRewardBench 等智能体基准上达到最优性能。

TLDR: LLM-as-a-Verifier introduces a probabilistic verification framework that computes continuous scores from LLM logits to evaluate solution correctness, achieving state-of-the-art results on agentic benchmarks including RoboRewardBench for robotics reward verification.

Abstract: Scaling pre-training, post-training, and test-time compute have become the central paradigms for improving the capabilities of LLMs. In this work, we identify verification, the ability to determine the correctness of a solution, as a new scaling axis. To unlock this and demonstrate its effectiveness, we introduce LLM-as-a-Verifier, a general-purpose verification framework that provides fine-grained feedback for agentic tasks without requiring additional training. Unlike standard LM judges that prompt LLMs to produce discrete scores for candidate solutions, LLM-as-a-Verifier computes the expectation over the distribution of scoring token logits to generate continuous scores. This probabilistic formulation enables verification to scale along multiple dimensions: (1) score granularity, (2) repeated evaluation, and (3) criteria decomposition. In particular, we show that scaling the scoring granularity leads to better separation between positive and negative solutions, resulting in more calibrated comparisons. Moreover, scaling repeated evaluation and criteria decomposition consistently lead to additional gains in verification accuracy through variance and complexity reduction. We further introduce a cost-efficient ranking algorithm for selecting the best solution among candidates using the verifier's continuous scores. LLM-as-a-Verifier achieves state-of-the-art performance on Terminal-Bench V2 (86.5%), SWE-Bench Verified (78.2%), RoboRewardBench (87.4%), and MedAgentBench (73.3%). Beyond verification, the fine-grained signals from LLM-as-a-Verifier can also serve as a proxy for estimating task progress. We build an extension for Claude Code, enabling developers to monitor and improve their own agentic systems. Finally, we show that LLM-as-a-Verifier can provide dense feedback for RL, improving the sample efficiency of SAC and GRPO on robotics and mathematical reasoning benchmarks.

摘要（中文）：缩放预训练、后训练和测试时计算已成为提升大语言模型（LLM）能力的主要范式。在本工作中，我们识别出验证能力——即判断解决方案正确性的能力——作为一个新的缩放维度。为解锁这一能力并证明其有效性，我们提出“LLM-as-a-Verifier”这一通用验证框架，其为智能体任务提供细粒度反馈，且无需额外训练。与通过提示LLM对候选方案输出离散分数的标准语言模型评判方法不同，LLM-as-a-Verifier通过对评分令牌logits的分布计算期望值以生成连续分数。这种概率化表述使得验证能在多个维度上实现缩放：（1）评分粒度、（2）重复评估、（3）标准分解。特别地，我们证明缩放评分粒度能更好地区分正负解决方案，从而产生更校准的比较。此外，重复评估与标准分解的缩放通过降低方差和复杂度持续带来验证准确率的额外提升。我们进一步提出一种基于验证器连续分数的成本高效排序算法，用于从候选方案中选出最优解。LLM-as-a-Verifier在Terminal-Bench V2（86.5%）、SWE-Bench Verified（78.2%）、RoboRewardBench（87.4%）及MedAgentBench（73.3%）上均达到当前最优性能。除验证功能外，LLM-as-a-Verifier产生的细粒度信号还可作为评估任务进度的代理指标。我们为Claude Code构建了扩展模块，使开发者能监控并改进自身的智能体系统。最后，我们证明LLM-as-a-Verifier能为强化学习提供密集反馈，从而提升SAC和GRPO在机器人学及数学推理基准上的样本效率。

Authors: Jacky Kwok, Shulu Li, Pranav Atreya, Yuejiang Liu, Yixing Jiang, Chelsea Finn, Marco Pavone, Ion Stoica, Azalia Mirhoseini

GaP: A Graph-as-Policy Multi-Agent Self-Learning Harness For Variational Automation Tasks Other

Graph-as-Policy multi-agent self-learning variational automation Task and Motion Planning Robot Operating System

简要说明：GaP 从模块化技能库生成有向计算图，并通过多智能体自学习在仿真中迭代优化图结构与参数，在仿真和真实世界的变分自动化任务上实现了高成功率。

TLDR: GaP generates directed computation graphs from a modular skill library and uses multi-agent self-learning in simulation to iteratively refine the graph structure and parameters, achieving high success rates on variational automation tasks in both simulation and the real world.

Abstract: For robots to work reliably in commercial and industrial applications, can recent advances in agentic coding systems combine interpretable robot programming with the open-world adaptability of model-free policies? We focus on "Variational Automation" (VA), a class of tasks that have larger variations in object geometry and pose than fixed automation. Model-free policies often struggle to close the reliability gap for VA tasks, which must be executed persistently and reliably in commercial and industrial applications. Motivated by prior work on Task and Motion Planning (TAMP) and the Robot Operating System (ROS), we introduce Graph-as-Policy (GaP), a multi-agent coding harness that generates directed computation graphs with perception, planning, and control nodes from a Modular Open Robot Skill Library (MORSL). GaP then generates an internal simulation environment to rehearse task instances with different graphs in parallel to iteratively refine the graph structure and parameters to improve success rates and throughput. Evaluation with 8 new open VA task benchmarks, 4 in-simulation and 4 in real-world, suggests that GaP can achieve success rates that significantly outperform baselines. Details, code, and data can be found online: https://graph-robots.github.io/gap

摘要（中文）：为使机器人在商业和工业应用中可靠运行，近期代理式编码系统的进展能否将可解释的机器人编程与无模型策略的开放世界适应性相结合？我们聚焦于“变分自动化”（VA），这是一类比固定自动化在物体几何形状和位姿上具有更大变化的任务。在商业和工业应用中，无模型策略往往难以弥合VA任务的可靠性差距，这类任务必须被持续且可靠地执行。受任务与运动规划（TAMP）及机器人操作系统（ROS）先前工作的启发，我们提出了“图即策略”（GaP），这是一种多智能体编码框架，能够从模块化开放机器人技能库（MORSL）中生成包含感知、规划与控制节点的有向计算图。随后，GaP生成内部仿真环境，并行地对不同图结构下的任务实例进行预演，以迭代优化图结构与参数，从而提升成功率和吞吐量。通过8个新的开放VA任务基准（4个仿真环境、4个真实场景）的评估表明，GaP能够取得显著优于基线方法的成功率。详情、代码与数据见在线资源：https://graph-robots.github.io/gap

Authors: Kaiyuan Chen, Shuangyu Xie, Letian Fu, Justin Yu, William Pacini, Sandeep Bajamahal, Hudson Kim, Jaimyn Drake, Daehwa Kim, Haoru Xue, Jonathan Francis, Christian Juette, Peter Schaldenbrand, Muhammet Yunus Seker, Ruwan Wickramarachchi, Uksang Yoo, Guanzhi Wang, Adithyavairavan Murali, Balakumar Sundaralingam, S. Shankar Sastry, Spencer Huang, Yuke Zhu, Linxi "Jim" Fan, Ken Goldberg

Socially-Aware Autonomous Doorway Traversal and Payload Delivery for Emergency Assistance Manipulation

behavior tree doorway traversal payload delivery human-aware navigation emergency evacuation

简要说明：一个基于行为树的框架使社交机器人能够在紧急疏散中自主通过门并运送物资，在105次模拟和真实试验中进行了验证。

TLDR: A behavior-tree framework enables a social robot to autonomously traverse doors and deliver payloads during emergency evacuations, validated across 105 simulated and real-world trials.

Abstract: In this work, we focus on the scenario of a robot-assisted emergency evacuation. We consider two capabilities relevant to such a setting. The first is opening doors ahead of the people being evacuated, so that their path toward an exit stays clear. The second is retrieving rescue equipment and delivering it to the emergency responders carrying out the evacuation. From a systems perspective, this involves several tasks at once. The robot must locate ADA-compliant door buttons and the rescue equipment it needs to retrieve. Additionally, it must remain aware of the people around it and adapt its behavior to them, so that it supports the evacuation rather than getting in the way. We address these demands with a behavior tree at the core of our framework. This structure is chosen for its ability to select high-level tasks based on environmental triggers, and to extend to new situations as they arise. We evaluate the system in 105 trials on the Toyota Human Support Robot, across five hardware and three simulation scenarios. These trials capture the decisions the robot must make in this setting: whether to press a door button, yield to a nearby person, walk through a door someone else is holding, or first retrieve rescue equipment before traversing the door. Overall, the system completes 97 of the 105 trials successfully. These results suggest our framework provides a practical basis for robotic assistance in broader emergency response tasks. Code and video demonstrations are available at https://github.com/AndrewSnowdy/hsr_mm_control.

摘要（中文）：在本研究中，我们聚焦于机器人辅助紧急疏散场景，并考虑了与此类情境相关的两种能力：其一是在被疏散人员前方打开门，确保其前往出口的通道畅通；其二是取回救援设备并将其交付给正在执行疏散任务的应急响应人员。从系统角度来看，这需要同时完成多项任务：机器人必须定位符合《美国残疾人法案》标准的门按钮及其所需的救援设备，同时需持续感知周围人员并相应调整自身行为，从而支持疏散过程而非造成阻碍。我们采用行为树作为框架核心来应对这些需求，该结构因能基于环境触发选择高层任务并具备扩展至新情境的能力而被选用。我们在丰田人体辅助机器人上进行了105次试验，涵盖五种硬件场景与三种仿真场景。这些试验捕捉了机器人在该情境下必须做出的决策：是否按下门按钮、为附近行人让行、穿过他人正在开启的门，或在穿越门前优先取回救援设备。整体上，系统在105次试验中成功完成97次。结果表明，我们的框架为机器人参与更广泛的应急响应任务提供了实用基础。代码及视频演示请见 https://github.com/AndrewSnowdy/hsr_mm_control。

Authors: Andrew Snowdy, Ananya Trivedi, Sarvesh Prajapati, Lorena Maria Genua, Taskin Padir

Multi-Robot Open Adaptive Teaming Across Unseen Environments, Partners, and Scales RLRobot

multi-robot teaming open adaptive learning hypergraphic game cooperative pursuit sim-to-real transfer

简要说明：提出了一种超图形式博弈公式和超图开放学习算法（HOLA），使多机器人团队能同时适应未知环境、未知伙伴和变化的团队规模，在多无人机和多四足平台上进行了验证，并实现了零样本的仿真到现实迁移。

TLDR: Proposes a hypergraphic-form game formulation and the Hypergraphic Open-ended Learning Algorithm (HOLA) for multi-robot teams to adapt simultaneously to unseen environments, unknown partners, and varying team sizes, demonstrated on multi-drone and multi-quadruped platforms with zero-shot sim-to-real transfer.

Abstract: Deploying robot teams in the real world requires simultaneous adaptation to unseen environments, unknown partners, and varying team sizes, yet existing approaches often address these challenges in isolation under the closed-world assumption of fixed teammates. We formalize this as open adaptive multi-robot teaming and propose a hypergraphic-form game formulation that captures team-level cooperative relationships beyond pairwise interactions, providing a principled foundation for coordination structure inference when team composition changes dynamically within episodes. Unlike graph neural network architectures, this is a game-theoretic construct for modeling strategic interactions and payoff structures among agents. Building on this formulation, we develop the Hypergraphic Open-ended Learning Algorithm (HOLA), which progressively expands partner and environment diversity during training rather than optimizing for fixed configurations. Evaluated on cooperative pursuit with multi-drone and multi-quadruped platforms, HOLA outperforms all baselines across all three adaptability dimensions. Learned policies transfer directly to physical hardware without fine-tuning, with successful deployments on Crazyflie and Zsibot L1 platforms confirming robust real-world coordination in novel environments with unseen teammates.

摘要（中文）：在现实世界中部署机器人团队需要同时适应未知环境、陌生伙伴以及动态变化的团队规模，然而现有方法往往在固定队友的封闭世界假设下孤立地应对这些挑战。本文将这一问题形式化为开放自适应多机器人协作，并提出一种基于超图形式博弈的建模框架，该框架能够捕捉超越两两交互的团队级协作关系，为团队构成在回合内动态变化时的协调结构推断提供了原理性基础。与图神经网络架构不同，这是一种用于建模智能体间策略互动与收益结构的博弈论方法。基于该框架，我们开发了超图开放式学习算法（HOLA），该算法在训练过程中逐步扩展伙伴与环境的多样性，而非针对固定配置进行优化。在多无人机与多四足机器人平台的协同追捕任务评估中，HOLA在所有三个适应性维度上均优于所有基线方法。学习得到的策略可直接迁移至物理硬件而无需微调，在Crazyflie与Zsibot L1平台上的成功部署验证了其在新颖环境与陌生队友场景下具备鲁棒的现实世界协调能力。

Authors: Yang Li, Feng Xue, Fan Mo, Yunhao Liu, Jianhong Wang, Ying Wen, Qingrui Zhang, Shaoshuai Mou, Wei Pan

Trajectory-Anchor Optimization for Overconfident Thermal Visual Place Recognition: Zero-Leakage OOD Auditing and Kidnapped-Robot Recovery VLN

thermal visual place recognition out-of-distribution detection kidnapped-robot recovery batched Procrustes alignment zero-leakage OOD auditing

简要说明：TAO 通过批量化 SE(2) Procrustes 对齐方法压缩多视角时间验证，在热红外视觉位置识别中检测灾难性失败，实现高效的绑架机器人恢复。

TLDR: TAO introduces a batched SE(2) Procrustes alignment method that compresses multi-view temporal verification to detect catastrophic failures in thermal visual place recognition under OOD conditions, enabling efficient kidnapped-robot recovery.

Abstract: Modern thermal visual place recognition (TIR-VPR) frontends based on foundation models achieve remarkable closed-set retrieval but suffer from an overconfident forced-matching failure mode. Under out-of-distribution (OOD) or unmapped conditions, they generate highly plausible yet false loop candidates without a drop in similarity scores. While classical multi-hypothesis tracking (MHT) backends can mitigate these ambiguities by maintaining divergent trajectory beliefs, their exponential computational overhead violates real-time robotic constraints. To bridge this gap, we present Trajectory-Anchor Optimization (TAO). To counter the combinatorial challenge of evaluating parallel hypotheses (e.g., K=100), TAO compresses multi-view temporal verification into a batched SE(2) Procrustes alignment problem. By leveraging tensor-level vectorization and single-invocation batched SVD, this formulation bypasses the dynamic tree expansion of MHT, guaranteeing a strictly bounded per-frame execution loop of O(KN). Under a strict zero-leakage evaluation protocol, we show that while a passive geometric backend cannot mathematically separate metric localization errors from coherent hallucinations at a micro-scale (<5m) due to local visual ambiguities, TAO serves as an efficient fail-safe filter at a macro-scale. Within a 5m radius, hallucinations often possess a locally consistent geometry that deceives rigid alignment. However, beyond this threshold, the K=100 disparate hypotheses disperse spatially across the global map. This dispersion breaks the rigid temporal co-visibility constraint within the sliding window (N=20), causing the joint optimization residual to escalate sharply. Consequently, TAO establishes a distinct macroscopic convergence basin (10m) where multi-view geometric consistency reliably isolates catastrophic topological breaks and suppresses critical false acceptances.

摘要（中文）：基于基础模型的现代热视觉地点识别（TIR-VPR）前端实现了显著的闭集检索性能，但存在过度自信的强制匹配失效模式。在分布外（OOD）或未映射条件下，此类系统会生成高度可信的假闭环候选，而相似度分数却未出现下降。尽管经典的多假设跟踪（MHT）后端可通过维持分歧性的轨迹信念来缓解此类歧义，但其指数级计算开销违背了实时机器人系统的约束。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了轨迹锚点优化（TAO）。为应对评估并行假设（例如K=100）的组合挑战，TAO将多视角时序验证压缩为批处理SE(2) Procrustes对齐问题。通过利用张量级向量化与单次调用批处理SVD，该公式绕过了MHT的动态树扩展，保证了严格有界的每帧执行循环O(KN)。在严格的零泄漏评估协议下，我们证明：尽管在微观尺度（<5m）上，由于局部视觉歧义，被动几何后端无法从数学上区分度量定位误差与连贯性幻觉，但TAO在宏观尺度上可作为高效的故障安全滤波器。在5m半径内，幻觉通常具有局部一致的几何结构，从而欺骗刚性对齐。然而超过此阈值时，K=100个分歧假设会在全局地图上空间分散。这种分散打破了滑动窗口内（N=20）刚性的时序共视约束，导致联合优化残差急剧增大。因此，TAO建立了一个独特的宏观收敛盆地（10m），在该范围内，多视角几何一致性可可靠地隔离灾难性拓扑断裂并抑制关键性误接受。

Authors: Zhiyuan Lu, Kanji Tanaka

Spatial Attention: Adapting Execution Horizons for Diffusion Policies via Observation Sensitivity Manipulation

diffusion policy execution horizon action chunk spatial attention robotic learning from demonstration

简要说明：本文提出了空间注意力（Spatial Attention），通过自适应调整扩散策略中动作块（action chunk）的执行周期长度，平衡响应速度与计算成本，在扰动任务上显著提升了成功率。

TLDR: This paper introduces Spatial Attention, a method that adaptively adjusts the execution horizon of action chunks in diffusion-based robotic policies to balance responsiveness and computational cost, improving success rates on perturbed tasks.

Abstract: Sampling action chunks via generative models has become a widely adopted methodology for robotic learning from demonstration. However, existing methods often struggle to balance responsiveness and computational cost because they execute each action chunk for a fixed execution horizon. In this paper, we adaptively adjust the execution horizon of sampled action chunks, balancing responsiveness and computational efficiency. We introduce Spatial Attention -- defined as the expected squared norm of the gradient of the action log-likelihood with respect to the observation -- which indicates the sensitivity of the policy's action distribution to variations in the observation. We show that, under a fixed budget of chunk samplings, the execution horizon that minimizes the cumulative likelihood drop induced by disturbances decreases as Spatial Attention increases. By forecasting future Spatial Attention values alongside the action chunk, our framework dynamically assigns shorter execution horizons to phases with high Spatial Attention, and longer horizons to phases with low Spatial Attention. Experiments on standard and perturbed tasks, in both simulation and on a real robot, show that our method significantly improves success rates over fixed-horizon baselines while maintaining the average execution horizon.

摘要（中文）：通过生成模型采样动作块已成为机器人从示范中学习的广泛采用方法。然而，现有方法常因对每个动作块采用固定执行周期，难以在响应速度与计算成本之间取得平衡。本文提出自适应调整采样动作块的执行周期，以平衡响应效率与计算开销。我们引入空间注意力——定义为动作对数似然关于观测梯度的期望平方范数——它表征策略动作分布对观测变化的敏感程度。研究表明，在固定采样预算下，使扰动引起的累积似然下降最小化的执行周期随空间注意力增大而缩短。通过预测未来空间注意力值并联合输出动作块，本框架为高空间注意力相位动态分配较短执行周期，为低空间注意力相位分配较长周期。在标准任务与扰动任务中的仿真及真实机器人实验表明，本方法在维持平均执行周期的同时，相较于固定周期基线方法显著提升了任务成功率。

Authors: Che-Sang Park, Junsu Ha, Jianlong Fu, Frank C. Park

Do Vision-Language-Action Models Mean What They Say? On the Role of Faithfulness in Embodied Reasoning AutonomousDriving

faithful reasoning embodied chain-of-thought vision-language-action autonomous driving reinforcement learning post-training

简要说明：本文研究了视觉-语言-动作模型中链式思维推理的忠实性，提出了用于衡量和提升忠实性的学习型评判器Pinocchio，并通过后训练证明，忠实推理能带来更鲁棒、更可泛化的自主驾驶具身策略。

TLDR: This paper studies the faithfulness of Chain-of-Thought reasoning in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, proposes Pinocchio, a learned critic to measure and improve faithfulness, and demonstrates through post-training that faithful reasoning leads to more robust and generalizable embodied policies in autonomous driving.

Abstract: Embodied Chain-of-Thought has emerged as a promising mechanism to enhance robot decision-making and interpretability in black-box Vision-Language Action (VLA) models. However, whether this verbalized Chain-of-Thought truthfully reflects the policy's underlying decision process remains poorly understood. We distinguish between functional reasoning, in which reasoning improves task performance, and faithful reasoning, in which reasoning truly reflects the policy's internal decision process. We argue that SoTA alignment strategies offer a necessary but insufficient notion of faithfulness, admitting reasoning whose intermediate steps can mask the causal links in action prediction through confounding factors (e.g., reasoning that is ungrounded in the environment and internally disconnected or inconsistent), restricting policy generalization. We study this gap through a human evaluation of a SoTA reasoning model for autonomous driving, revealing an inconsistent coupling between reasoning quality and downstream trajectory improvement. We then operationalize a behavioral surrogate for embodied faithfulness through a learned critic, Pinocchio, scoring observation grounding and stepwise coherence, and use this critic as a dense reward signal in post-training an embodied policy with reinforcement learning. Across withheld driving benchmarks, our post-trained planner improves faithfulness by 4% and 18% over SoTA alignment and trajectory error post-training baselines, respectively, while maintaining competitive downstream task performance. Finally, on a synthetic out-of-distribution test set, post-training for faithfulness improves policy responsiveness to rare counterfactual scenarios by 1.6x that of a SoTA policy, suggesting that faithful reasoning traces contribute to more robust, generalizable, and interpretable embodied intelligence. Project page: https://mjf-su.github.io/pinocchio/

摘要（中文）：具身思维链（Embodied Chain-of-Thought）已成为增强黑箱视觉-语言-行动（VLA）模型中机器人决策能力与可解释性的一种有前景机制。然而，这种语言化的思维链是否真实反映策略的内在决策过程，目前仍缺乏深入理解。我们将功能性推理（通过推理提升任务性能）与忠实性推理（推理真正反映策略内部决策过程）加以区分。我们认为，现有最优（SoTA）对齐策略提供了必要但非充分的忠实性概念——其允许推理的中间步骤通过混杂因素（例如未基于环境且内部不连贯或矛盾的推理）掩盖行动预测中的因果关联，从而限制策略的泛化能力。我们通过针对自动驾驶领域SoTA推理模型的人工评估来研究这一差距，揭示推理质量与下游轨迹优化之间存在不一致的耦合关系。随后，我们通过一个名为Pinocchio的学习型评价器，将具身忠实性的行为替代指标加以操作化——该评价器对观测环境锚定与逐步骤连贯性进行评分，并利用该评价器作为密集奖励信号，在具身策略的后训练阶段进行强化学习。在多个保留的驾驶基准测试中，经后训练的规划器比SoTA对齐基准和轨迹误差后训练基准分别提升了4%和18%的忠实性，同时保持具有竞争力的下游任务性能。最后，在一组合成的分布外测试集上，针对忠实性进行后训练使策略对罕见反事实场景的响应能力提升至SoTA策略的1.6倍，这表明忠实性推理轨迹有助于构建更鲁棒、更具泛化能力且更可解释的具身智能。项目主页：https://mjf-su.github.io/pinocchio/

Authors: Matthew Foutter, Matteo Cercola, Lena Wild, Yunshan Wang, Michelle Li, Daniele Gammelli, Marco Pavone

RoboVista: Evaluating Vision Language Models for Diverse Robot Applications VLA

VQA benchmark modular evaluation Vision-Language Models robotic reasoning domain diversity

简要说明：提出 RoboVista，一个涵盖多种机器人领域的 474 个 VQA 实例的基准测试，以及模块化评估框架 RQA，用于评估 VLM 在机器人应用中的推理能力；实验表明与真实机器人性能强相关。

TLDR: Proposes RoboVista, a VQA benchmark with 474 instances across diverse robotic domains, and a modular evaluation framework (RQA) to assess VLM reasoning for robot applications; shows correlation with real-robot performance.

Abstract: Diverse applications for robotics, such as industry and agriculture, require robots to operate across various embodiments, changing visual conditions, and complex planning. Vision-Language Models (VLMs) offer a promising foundation for general-purpose and interpretable robotic reasoning. Aligning VLMs with diverse robot applications requires a modular understanding of the individual decision components that underlie robotic behavior. Capturing such structure is challenging for conventional robot benchmarks that are primarily based on teleoperated, end-to-end datasets. We propose Robot Question Answering (RQA), a modular evaluation framework and RoboVista, a benchmark curated from real robotic systems, research papers, and expert annotations. RoboVista contains 474 Visual Question Answering (VQA) instances with human annotated reasoning and covers 39 unique task types in agricultural, industrial, domestic, surgical robotics, autonomous driving, and open robot datasets. Experiments on RoboVista show that state-of-the-art VLMs exhibit substantial gaps. Physical robot experiments suggest strong correlation between RoboVista performance and real-world task execution.

摘要（中文）：机器人技术的多样化应用（如工业与农业）要求机器人能够在不同形态、变化的视觉条件及复杂规划中运行。视觉语言模型（VLM）为通用且可解释的机器人推理提供了极具前景的基础。要使VLM适配多样化的机器人应用，需要对其底层决策组件进行模块化理解。传统的机器人基准测试主要基于远程操作生成的端到端数据集，难以捕捉此类结构。为此，我们提出机器人问答（RQA）模块化评估框架，并构建了来自真实机器人系统、研究论文及专家标注的基准数据集RoboVista。该数据集包含474个视觉问答（VQA）实例（附带人工标注的推理过程），覆盖农业、工业、家政、手术机器人、自动驾驶及开放机器人数据集的39种独特任务类型。在RoboVista上的实验表明，当前最先进的VLM仍存在显著能力差距。物理机器人实验证实，RoboVista性能与真实世界任务执行之间存在强相关性。

Authors: Shuangyu Xie, Kaiyuan Chen, Ziyang Chen, Simeon Adebola, Yixuan Huang, Zehan Ma, Tianshuang Qiu, Wentao Yuan, Dhruv Shah, Pannag R. Sanketi, Ken Goldberg

HUGS: Guiding Unified Dexterous Grasp Synthesis Across Modes and Scales via Learned Human Priors Manipulation

dexterous grasp synthesis human prior force-closure optimization multi-modal grasping grasp dataset

简要说明：HUGS通过人类先验引导的统一灵巧抓取合成框架，覆盖多种模式和尺度，利用紧凑的人类数据集生成多样化的机器人抓取。

TLDR: HUGS learns a human-prior-guided framework for unified dexterous grasp synthesis across various modes and scales, enabling generation of diverse robotic grasps from a compact human dataset.

Abstract: Dexterous grasping across diverse object scales requires contact modes ranging from two-finger pinches to bimanual grasps. Existing dexterous grasp synthesis methods reduce the high-dimensional optimization space with manually designed expected contacts and initialization heuristics, which struggle to balance synthesis success rate and diversity. We present HUGS (Human-prior-guided Unified Dexterous Grasp Synthesis), a human-prior-guided framework for unified dexterous grasp synthesis across modes and scales. Instead of directly retargeting human demonstrations, HUGS learns an object-conditioned human prior that captures human grasp preferences and guides downstream force-closure-aware optimization. The prior is trained on a compact self-collected human grasp dataset with 1.8K grasps over 304 objects, providing broad coverage of object scales and contact modes. During synthesis, HUGS adaptively proposes contact modes and wrist initializations, substantially improving the balance between contact-mode coverage and synthesis success rate over heuristic-based methods. With HUGS, we synthesize 3.2M robotic grasps over 157K scenes, spanning object half-diagonal lengths from 2 cm to 30 cm and modes from two-finger to bimanual grasps. Models trained on the synthesized dataset autonomously select appropriate contact modes in the real world, enabling grasping from screws to large boxes.

摘要（中文）：摘要：跨越多尺度物体的灵巧抓取需要从双指捏合到双臂抓取等多种接触模式。现有的灵巧抓取综合方法通过人工设计的预期接触点和初始化启发式策略来降低高维优化空间，但难以平衡综合成功率与多样性。本文提出HUGS（人类先验引导的统一灵巧抓取综合框架），一种基于人类先验的统一跨模式跨尺度灵巧抓取综合框架。不同于直接重定向人类演示数据，HUGS学习一个物体条件化的人类先验，该先验捕获人类抓取偏好并指导后续的力闭合感知优化。该先验基于自采集的紧凑型人类抓取数据集进行训练，该数据集包含304个物体上的1,800次抓取，覆盖了广泛的物体尺度与接触模式。在综合过程中，HUGS自适应地提出接触模式与腕部初始位姿，相较于基于启发式的方法显著提升了接触模式覆盖率与综合成功率之间的平衡。利用HUGS，我们在157K场景中综合了320万次机器人抓取，涵盖物体半对角线长度从2厘米到30厘米的尺度范围，以及从双指到双臂的多模式抓取。基于该综合数据集训练的模型能够在真实世界中自主选择适当的接触模式，实现从螺丝钉到大型箱体的抓取操作。

Authors: Mingrui Yu, Yongpeng Jiang, Yongyi Jia, Kangchen Lv, Li Huang, Yi Ren, Xiang Li

MoP-JEPA: Hard-Assigned Predictor Mixtures for Stochastic JEPA World Models WorldModel

JEPA world model mixture of predictors hard assignment stochastic transitions planning

简要说明：提出了 MoP-JEPA，一种用于 JEPA 世界模型的硬分配混合专家预测器，解决了随机环境中的模态平均崩溃问题，实现了在模拟迷宫和真实环境中的有效规划。

TLDR: Proposes MoP-JEPA, a hard-assigned mixture-of-experts predictor for JEPA world models that resolves the mode-averaging collapse in stochastic environments, enabling effective planning in simulated mazes and real-world execution.

Abstract: JEPA world models predict the next latent state with a single deterministic predictor trained by latent regression. We show that this fails structurally when the environment is stochastic: at a branching transition, the regression-optimal predictor outputs the conditional mean of the successor embeddings, a point between the true next states that corresponds to no state at all. We prove this collapse for deterministic and gated mixture-of-experts predictors, and prove that MoP-JEPA's hard-assigned predictors converge instead to a quantizer of the transition distribution: one head per successor mode, enumerable in a single forward pass, which is the interface a planner consumes. On official OGBench offline data with leak-free evaluation, planning over single-predictor rollouts performs poorly ($0.02$--$0.09$ success) while planning over our predicted modes reaches up to $0.85$, ahead of deterministic, gated-MoE, and variational predictors on every task. Because multi-prediction evaluation invites coverage freeloading, a verification protocol is part of the method: an input-agnostic codebook control, a shuffled-context test, router-gated readouts, transition-precision guards, and a verified-route criterion in which the model proposes its transition graph blind and ground truth is used only to check the result. Under this criterion our method outperforms the strongest soft alternative on all three mazes ($2$--$5\times$), and the protocol identifies the remaining gap in that baseline's raw scores as routes through predicted transitions that do not exist. The same model executes in the real environment, placing second of seven against the published OGBench baselines on the hardest maze. Multimodal dynamics decide whether a JEPA world model can plan at all; a mixture of predictors with hard assignment is a minimal and verifiable fix.

摘要（中文）：JEPA 世界模型通过一个由潜在回归训练的单一确定性预测器来预测下一个潜在状态。我们证明，当环境具有随机性时，该方法在结构上会失效：在分支转移中，回归最优预测器会输出后继嵌入的条件均值，即位于真实下一状态之间的一个点，而该点并不对应任何实际状态。我们针对确定性预测器和门控混合专家预测器证明了这种塌缩现象，并证明 MoP-JEPA 的硬分配预测器反而会收敛为转移分布的量化器：每个后继模态对应一个预测头，可在单次前向传播中枚举，这正是规划器所需的接口。在官方 OGBench 离线数据上进行的无泄漏评估中，基于单一预测器展开的规划性能极差（成功率 0.02–0.09），而基于我们预测模态的规划成功率最高可达 0.85，在所有任务上均优于确定性、门控 MoE 以及变分预测器。由于多预测评估容易引发覆盖率投机问题，验证协议成为该方法的一部分：包括一个与输入无关的码本控制、混洗上下文测试、路由门控读出、转移精度守卫，以及一个验证路径准则——模型盲提其转移图，仅使用真实数据来校验结果。在该准则下，我们的方法在所有三个迷宫中均优于最强的软性替代方案（2–5 倍），并且该协议将基线原始分数中的剩余差距识别为通过不存在的预测转移所规划的路径。同一模型在真实环境中执行，在已发布的 OGBench 基线中于最难迷宫上排名第二（共七组）。多模态动力学决定了 JEPA 世界模型是否具备规划能力；而采用硬分配的混合预测器是一种最小且可验证的修复方案。

Authors: Zhi Song, Ximing Xing, Zhenchao Tang, hanbo Huang, Tianxu Lv, minghao Yang, Zhongzheng Niu, He Bing, Lusheng Wang, Jianhua Yao

Targeted Structure Completion for Sparse-View 3D Reconstruction in Autonomous Driving Perception3D

3D reconstruction sparse-view geometric ambiguity Gaussian queries autonomous driving

简要说明：FocusGS提出了一种针对自动驾驶中稀疏视图三维重建的目标结构补全框架，通过将计算集中在几何模糊区域，实现了更好的效率-质量权衡。

TLDR: FocusGS proposes a targeted structure completion framework for sparse-view 3D reconstruction in autonomous driving, achieving a better efficiency-quality trade-off by focusing computation on geometrically ambiguous regions.

Abstract: Reconstructing 3D scene structures from sparse, low-overlap observations remains a fundamental challenge in autonomous driving. Recent state-of-the-art frameworks achieve promising results by incorporating voxel-based Gaussians, but incur substantial computational redundancy due to a uniform volumetric processing strategy. To bridge the gap between the efficiency of pixel-based Gaussian methods and the structural completeness of voxel-based Gaussian approaches, we propose FocusGS, a simple yet effective framework that shifts the paradigm from global densification to targeted structural completion. Our central insight is that structural completion should be decoupled from deterministic regions, with computation concentrated exclusively on areas exhibiting geometric ambiguity. Specifically, FocusGS addresses the localization challenge by deriving a 3D Geometric Ambiguity Manifold to accurately isolate localized areas prone to occlusion and high geometric uncertainty. To overcome the subsequent manifold completion challenge, we design a lightweight targeted structure completion module that selectively instantiates and optimizes continuous Gaussian queries strictly within this unstructured, sparse topological subspace. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FocusGS achieves a superior efficiency-quality trade-off, advancing state-of-the-art performance on driving-centric benchmarks while naturally reducing the total number of Gaussians by ~74% and decreasing rendering time by ~34%.

摘要（中文）：从稀疏、低重叠观测数据中重建三维场景结构仍是自动驾驶领域的一项基本挑战。现有最先进的框架通过引入基于体素的高斯方法取得了令人鼓舞的结果，但由于采用均匀的体积处理策略，导致了大量计算冗余。为弥合基于像素的高斯方法的高效性与基于体素的高斯方法的结构完整性之间的差距，我们提出FocusGS——一个简单而有效的框架，将范式从全局密集化转向针对性结构补全。我们的核心见解在于：结构补全应与确定性区域解耦，计算资源仅集中于存在几何模糊性的区域。具体而言，FocusGS通过推导三维几何模糊流形来解决定位难题，从而精确分离出易受遮挡和高几何不确定性影响的局部区域。为克服后续的流形补全挑战，我们设计了一个轻量级的针对性结构补全模块，该模块在此非结构化、稀疏的拓扑子空间中，选择性地实例化并优化连续高斯查询。大量实验表明，FocusGS实现了优越的效率-质量权衡，在驾驶中心基准测试上提升了最先进性能，同时自然地将高斯总数减少约74%，渲染时间缩短约34%。

Authors: Guoqing Wang, Pin Tang, Xiangxuan Ren, Liping Hou, Chao Ma

Beyond Isolated Objects: Relationship-aware Open Vocabulary Scene Understanding via 3D Scene Graph Analysis Perception3D

3D scene graphs open-vocabulary 3D understanding vision-language reasoning graph attention network contextual refinement

简要说明：RelGraphOV 通过构建和推理捕捉物体关系的 3D 场景图，并使用门控双流图注意力网络融合几何和语义特征，提升了开放词汇 3D 场景理解的能力。

TLDR: RelGraphOV enhances open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding by constructing and reasoning over 3D scene graphs that capture object relationships, using a gated dual-stream graph attention network to fuse geometric and semantic features.

Abstract: Open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding aims to segment 3D scenes beyond predefined categories by transferring semantic knowledge from vision-language models. Existing methods have advanced this task by lifting language-aligned 2D features into 3D, yet they often rely on context-independent semantic representations, leaving object relationships underexplored for contextual refinement. We propose RelGraphOV, a relationship-aware framework that uses 3D scene graphs to enhance open-vocabulary 3D understanding. Our method constructs relational scene graphs from multi-view observations by leveraging vision-language reasoning to infer object relationships and prune geometrically implausible connections, without manual relationship annotations. To aggregate relational context while avoiding feature interference, we introduce an Adaptive Gated Dual-Stream Contextual GAT that separates dense geometric features and semantic CLIP embeddings, performs edge-guided message passing, and adaptively fuses complementary semantics. A hierarchical contrastive objective further promotes instance-level consistency and category-level discrimination. Experiments on ScanNetV2, ScanNet200, ScanNet$++$, and Replica demonstrate strong performance and generalization ability. Project Page: https://cxavireh.github.io/relgraphov-projectpage

摘要（中文）：开放词汇三维场景理解旨在通过迁移视觉-语言模型的语义知识，分割超出预定义类别的三维场景。现有方法通过将语言对齐的二维特征提升至三维空间推进了该任务，但其往往依赖与上下文无关的语义表征，未充分挖掘物体间关系以实现上下文精炼。我们提出RelGraphOV——一种利用三维场景图增强开放词汇三维理解的关系感知框架。该方法通过多视角观测构建关系场景图，借助视觉-语言推理推断物体关系并修剪几何上不合理的连接，无需手动标注关系。为在聚合关系上下文的同时避免特征干扰，我们引入自适应门控双流上下文图注意力网络（Adaptive Gated Dual-Stream Contextual GAT），该网络分离密集几何特征与语义CLIP嵌入，执行边引导的消息传递，并自适应融合互补语义信息。层次化对比目标进一步促进实例级一致性与类别级区分能力。在ScanNetV2、ScanNet200、ScanNet$++$及Replica上的实验展示了其强大性能与泛化能力。项目页面：https://cxavireh.github.io/relgraphov-projectpage

Authors: Xianhao Chen, Jiarui Hu, Yuanbo Yang, Xiyu Zhang, Tengyue Wang, Hujun Bao, Guofeng Zhang, Zhaopeng Cui

ECO: Incremental Ego-Centric Octree Update for Point Streams Perception3D

ego-centric octree 3D sliding window incremental update real-time spatial perception KITTI

简要说明：ECO提出了一种以自我为中心的八叉树，作为3D滑动窗口用于实时点流处理，在KITTI上将更新速度降低高达67.52%。

TLDR: ECO presents an ego-centric octree that acts as a 3D sliding window for real-time point stream processing, reducing update times by up to 67.52% on KITTI.

Abstract: Constructing octrees for mobile robots that process continuous point streams in real time poses significant computational and memory challenges. Standard global structures often suffer from high latency and unbalanced tree growth. We introduce the Ego-Centric Octree (ECO), a spatial data structure that acts as a 3D sliding window, dynamically bounding the mapping space to the robot's immediate surroundings. ECO uses an efficient incremental update algorithm that categorizes the environment into shift-out, shift-in, and overlap regions, eliminating redundant global coordinate transformations. Evaluations on the KITTI benchmark demonstrate that ECO reduces update times by up to 25.60% (24.87% on average) compared to full static reconstruction and by up to 67.52% (54.60% on average) compared to a bounded incremental baseline. Furthermore, ECO substantially lowers the total system latency of downstream tasks, running up to 34.17% faster than full reconstruction in voxel-map generation. In dynamic scenes, ECO naturally retains a short-term temporal memory of moving objects, providing useful temporal context while keeping update cost bounded and the tree balanced for real-time spatial perception.

摘要（中文）：为实时处理连续点云流的移动机器人构建八叉树，在计算与内存方面均面临重大挑战。标准全局结构常存在高延迟与树结构生长失衡的问题。我们提出"自我中心八叉树"（ECO），这是一种空间数据结构，可作为3D滑动窗口，动态地将建图空间限定于机器人即时周围环境。ECO采用高效的增量更新算法，将环境划分为移出区、移入区与重叠区三类区域，从而消除冗余的全局坐标变换。在KITTI基准测试上的评估表明，相较完整静态重建，ECO更新耗时降低达25.60%（平均24.87%）；相较有界增量基准方法，更新耗时降低达67.52%（平均54.60%）。此外，ECO显著降低了下游任务的系统总延迟，在体素地图生成中运行速度比完整重建快达34.17%。在动态场景中，ECO自然地保留了移动物体的短期时间记忆，在保证更新成本可控且树结构平衡的同时，为实时空间感知提供有效的时间上下文信息。

Authors: Jaemin Yu, Seongyoon Jeong, Kang-Wook Chon, Duksu Kim

Multiplayer Interactive World Models with Representation Autoencoders WorldModel

multiplayer world model latent diffusion model Rocket League action-conditioned world model long-horizon stability

简要说明：本文提出了首个多人世界模型，在《火箭联盟》游戏中进行训练，使用潜在扩散模型生成以多个智能体动作为条件的、长时间稳定的连贯滚动。

TLDR: This paper presents the first multiplayer world model trained on Rocket League gameplay, using a latent diffusion model to generate coherent long-horizon rollouts conditioned on multiple agents' actions.

Abstract: We introduce the first multiplayer world model for highly dynamic environments governed by complex physical interactions. Whereas single-player world models treat the other agents as part of the environment, ours conditions on the action streams of multiple agents, learning to attribute changes in the scene to the correct player and to stay coherent under arbitrary combinations of their actions. We study this problem in the game of Rocket League, where players compete and cooperate under fast, tightly coupled dynamics. Trained on 10,000 hours of gameplay collected with publicly available bots, our 5-billion-parameter latent diffusion model generates four-player matches in real time, producing 20 frames per second on a single Nvidia B200 GPU. Although trained only on short clips, its rollouts stay stable far beyond the training horizon: distributional quality holds steady out to five minutes, the longest horizon we measure, and in practice we observe rollouts continuing for hours with no sign of collapse. We systematically investigate the central design choices: the video codec, the generative objective, and the multiplayer conditioning scheme. In addition, we characterize how behavior changes with model and data scale, including the capabilities that emerge and the failure modes that persist. We further develop targeted evaluations that probe the model's physical understanding rather than visual appearance alone. To support continued research on multiplayer world models, we release our dataset, our full training and inference codebase, and a live demo.

摘要（中文）：我们首次提出了适用于由复杂物理相互作用主导的高动态环境的多智能体世界模型。与将其他智能体视为环境一部分的单智能体世界模型不同，我们的模型以多个智能体的动作流为条件，学习将场景变化归因于正确的玩家，并在任意动作组合下保持一致性。我们在《火箭联盟》游戏中研究了这一问题，该游戏的特点是玩家在快速、紧密耦合的动态环境中进行竞争与合作。基于公开机器人收集的10,000小时游戏数据进行训练，我们的50亿参数潜扩散模型能够实时生成四人比赛场景，在单个Nvidia B200 GPU上每秒生成20帧。尽管仅使用短片段进行训练，其推演在远超训练时域的情况下仍保持稳定：分布质量在长达五分钟（我们测量的最长时域）内保持稳定，且实践中我们观察到推演可持续数小时而无崩溃迹象。我们系统研究了核心设计选择：视频编解码器、生成目标函数以及多智能体条件机制。此外，我们刻画了行为随模型和数据规模变化的特点，包括涌现的能力与持续存在的失败模式。我们还开发了针对性的评估方法，以探查模型对物理机制的理解（而非仅关注视觉表现）。为支持多智能体世界模型的持续研究，我们公开了数据集、完整的训练与推理代码库以及在线演示。
